items.title: 〈台股風向球〉連環套賣壓需時間換空間 長期投資人心態先穩住
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Outlook: Sequential Selling Pressure Needs Time to Create Space; Long-Term Investors Should Keep Calm
paras: 台股過去一周湧出連鎖多殺多賣壓，共爆挫7641點、跌幅高達17.5%，金管會實施全面限空令，且上周五台積電最後一盤也湧現超過1萬張的買單，顯示國家隊全力護盤的意念，不過，法人提醒，上周五美股重挫令台股本周空頭巨浪持續席捲，融資斷頭恐全面殺出，籌碼要沉澱短期非易事，「長期投資人時間換取空間，個人心態先穩住」。
上周五台股爆發逃命賣壓，緊接著美股又重挫，法人不諱言，這波大盤修正恐比過去影響範圍更廣的原因在於─更多小資散戶「在船上」；由於對AI發展趨勢的強勁信心使拉回就有低接買盤，反而在現階段形成上檔重重連環套，而先無論投資金額大小，負面感受恐較以往更深刻，不過，內資已紛紛給出正向的鼓舞。
元大投顧分析，最新美銀美林基金經理人調查報告顯示，華爾街大砍科技股力道創20 年新高，反映 AI 投資帶進的收入難跟上資本支出投入速度，加上民主黨勝選後資料中心建置可能延宕或受限，造成股市本益比壓縮，因此，台股從逼近5萬點的 22 倍本益比，逐步下跌到 16.5倍本益比，重新回到過去合理區間 14-18 倍本益比當中。
不過，因調整仍在持續，布局上仍以降低槓桿與持股水位為優先，建議在行情未正式出現轉機訊息前勿貿然攤平。
永豐投顧分析，金管會祭出新的限空措施，使台股空方力道受到抑制，有助市場提早尋求短期平衡點，但因相關措施不利市場流動性，建議先觀望等待。
由於此次大盤重挫是涉及AI產業資本支出和CSP擴張策略調整，與過去單純因高槓桿操作所造成的修正有所不同，提防貿然搶反彈的風險。
短線先觀察美國國會已邀請黃仁勳在12月1日出席國會聽證，因聽證結果具高度不確定性，若聽證結果侷限於個人私德，或許對輝達影響有限，若是牽涉到晶片出口是否合規，則牽涉範圍廣泛。
paras_en: The Taiwan stock market saw a cascade of selling pressure over the past week, wiping out 7,641 points and a drop of up to 17.5%. The Financial Supervisory Commission imposed a comprehensive short‑selling ban, and on Friday the last session of TSMC saw more than 10,000 buy orders, indicating the state’s full‑scale market‑support effort. However, institutions warned that Friday’s sharp decline in U.S. equities would keep a wave of short‑selling rolling over Taiwan stocks this week, with margin calls potentially triggering a broad sell‑off. It will not be easy for capital to settle in the short term; long‑term investors should use time to regain space and keep their mindset steady.

On Friday the Taiwan market erupted with panic selling, followed immediately by a further plunge in U.S. markets. Institutions did not hide the fact that this correction could be broader than previous ones because more small‑investor retail participants are “on board.” Strong confidence in AI trends created low‑price buying when the market pulled back, but at the current level the market is hitting multiple resistance layers, and negative sentiment feels deeper than before regardless of investment size. Nevertheless, domestic investors are beginning to voice optimism.

Yuanta Securities analysis cites the latest Bank of America Merrill Lynch fund‑manager survey, which shows Wall Street’s massive cuts to tech stocks hitting a 20‑year high. This reflects that AI‑driven revenue growth cannot keep pace with capital‑expenditure outlays, and that after the Democratic victory data‑center build‑outs may be delayed or constrained, compressing market P/E ratios. Consequently, Taiwan’s P/E has fallen from a peak of about 22× near the 50,000‑point level to roughly 16.5×, returning to a historically reasonable range of 14‑18×.

However, because the adjustment is still ongoing, the priority in portfolio construction remains reducing leverage and lowering position sizes. It is advised not to flatten positions rashly before clear signs of a market turnaround emerge.

Yongfeng Securities analysis notes that the Financial Supervisory Commission’s new short‑selling restrictions have dampened bearish pressure, helping the market seek a short‑term balance point earlier. Yet, because the measures may hurt market liquidity, the recommendation is to adopt a wait‑and‑see stance.

The current market plunge is tied to AI‑industry capital spending and CSP expansion‑strategy adjustments, which differ from past corrections driven solely by high leverage. Investors should guard against the risk of jumping in prematurely on a rebound.

In the short term, watch the U.S. Congress hearing scheduled for December 1, where Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has been invited. The outcome is highly uncertain: if the hearing focuses only on personal conduct, the impact on Nvidia may be limited; if it addresses the compliance of chip exports, the ramifications could be far‑reaching.

items.title: 加密貨幣失寵 昔日支持者加速認賠出場
items.title_en: Cryptocurrency Loses Favor, Former Supporters Accelerate Loss‑Taking Exit
paras: 隨著價格重挫、交易量萎縮與駭客攻擊頻傳，加密貨幣市場正面臨顯著退潮。
比特幣近期跌破 57,742 美元，創 2024 年 9 月以來新低，並朝向 2022 年以來最長週連跌邁進。加密貨幣總市值已縮減至約 2 兆美元，僅為去年高點的一半；以太幣跌幅逾 60%，Solana 更重挫近三分之二。
宏觀利空與突發事件交織衝擊市場。美元走強、美國聯準會(Fed)升息押注升溫，加上幣安遭逢創紀錄駭客攻擊，均加劇了賣壓。
美國股市剛剛經歷了慘烈的一周，截至周五的五個交易日中，標普500指數下跌8.6%，以科技股為主的那斯達克100指數跌幅更大。此前Anthropic上市帶來的亢奮，已經不敵市場對通膨和AI支出的新一輪擔憂。
GSR 資產管理董事總經理Andy Baehr指出：「整體市場已轉向嚴重缺乏信心，投資人正在降低風險曝險，主因包括預期聯準會升息、Anthropic 上市後亢奮消退及科技領域混亂，比特幣也未能倖免。」
數據顯示投資人正加速認賠離場。CryptoQuant 統計指出，過去一個月短期持有者轉入前五大交易所逾 70 萬枚比特幣，多數處於虧損狀態。
56 歲紐約散戶投資人Scott Kantrowitz表示，他已認賠賣出富達現貨比特幣與以太幣 ETF，轉投 SpaceX 與 Anthropic 股票，並直言：「我對它厭倦了，它就那麼躺在投資組合裡什麼都沒做。」
加密貨幣受寵程度降低，並不代表投機資金逐漸消失，而是轉向 AI 股票、預測市場(押注選舉與財報)及永續期貨。紐約甚至出現幫助玩家轉移興趣的社交聚會，活動發起人James Steinberg對此總結：「加密貨幣正在淡出時代潮流。」
paras_en: As prices plunge, trading volume shrinks and hacker attacks become frequent, the cryptocurrency market is facing a pronounced downturn.

Bitcoin recently fell below $57,742, hitting a new low since September 2024 and moving toward the longest weekly decline since 2022. The total crypto market cap has contracted to about $2 trillion, roughly half of last year’s peak; Ether has dropped more than 60%, and Solana has slumped nearly two‑thirds.

Macro‑level headwinds and sudden events are colliding to hit the market. A stronger dollar, rising expectations of Fed rate hikes, and Binance’s record‑breaking hack have all intensified selling pressure.

U.S. equities just endured a brutal week; in the five trading days through Friday, the S&P 500 fell 8.6% and the tech‑heavy Nasdaq‑100 slipped even more. The excitement from Anthropic’s IPO has been eclipsed by fresh worries over inflation and AI spending.

GSR Asset Management’s Managing Director Andy Baehr said, “The overall market has shifted to a severe confidence deficit, with investors cutting risk exposure. The drivers are expectations of Fed hikes, the fade‑out of Anthropic‑IPO hype, and turmoil in the tech sector—Bitcoin is not immune.”
Data show investors are accelerating loss‑taking exits. CryptoQuant reports that over the past month short‑term holders moved more than 700,000 BTC to the top five exchanges, most of them at a loss.

56‑year‑old New York retail investor Scott Kantrowitz said he has taken a loss and sold his Fidelity spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs, shifting into SpaceX and Anthropic stocks, adding, “I’m tired of it; it just sits in the portfolio doing nothing.”

The waning appeal of crypto does not mean speculative capital is disappearing, but rather moving into AI stocks, prediction markets (betting on elections and earnings) and perpetual futures. In New York, social gatherings have even sprung up to help players shift interests; organizer James Steinberg summed it up: “Cryptocurrency is fading out of the zeitgeist.”

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：美國10月PCE、Q3 GDP修正值及南韓央行利率決議
items.title_en: Weekly Trading Notes: US October PCE, Q3 GDP Revision and South Korea Central Bank Rate Decision
paras: 在經歷科技與人工智慧(AI)概念股劇烈震盪與市場拉回後，全球金融市場迎來數據緊湊的一週。本週適逢美國感恩節假期，美國市場交易時間縮短，投資人需在週四休市前消化一連串關鍵宏觀經濟數據。
關鍵數據包含美國聯準會(Fed)最關注的通膨指標——個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數，以及第三季GDP修正值。同時，南韓央行將召開利率會議，市場普遍預期其將重啟升息步伐。

本週操盤筆記 (1122-1128)

1.美國PCE通膨指標登場
本週美國經濟數據集中於週二與週三釋出。金融市場最關注的焦點為10月 PCE 物價指數。
根據機構預估，10月整體 PCE 與核心 PCE 物價指數月增率均約為 0.3%，反映底層物價壓力依然具有韌性。若數據符合預期，將進一步支持聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)在12月維持限制性貨幣政策或審慎調控的立場。
在消費與所得方面，10月個人所得受醫療保險保費退費及部分軍人福利提前發放等因素推升，月增率預估可達 0.3%；個人支出月增率則預估為 0.4%。此外，美國第三季 GDP 季增年率修正值預計維持在 3.4% 至 3.5% 的穩健水準，而10月耐久財訂單受科技與航太資本支出支持，預估成長 0.5%。
另一方面，感恩節黑色星期五與網路星期一購物季即將開跑，但分析指出，今年零售商的折扣力道顯著減弱。
2.南韓央行利率決議
在全球央行方面，南韓央行(BOK)將於週四召開貨幣政策會議。由於南韓10月核心 CPI 年增率維持在 2.8% 的偏高水準，加上第三季 GDP 成長超預期及人工智慧帶動的半導體出口強勁，市場預期南韓央行將重啟緊縮，將基準利率上調 25 個基點(1碼)至 3.25%。
3.歐洲央行公布會議紀要
歐洲央行(ECB)將於週四公布最近一次貨幣政策會議紀要，本次歐洲央行決議維持基準利率不變。央行在會議中警示，高企的能源價格可能進一步推升通膨，同時也會對整體經濟活動造成壓抑，並表達對二次通膨壓力的持續擔憂。
會議紀要將揭露官員對歐元區經濟成長動能、需求趨緩(如法國與歐元區 PMI 指標所反映的疲軟)以及供應鏈成本變化的內部討論細節，提供市場評估歐洲央行後續利率走向的重要依據。
4.全球PMI檢視成長動能
在宏觀經濟數據方面，美、歐、英、日、澳等多國將陸續發布11月 S&P Global 採購經理人指數(PMI)初值。
美國與英國的製造業與服務業預計持續擴張，而法國與德國的景氣表現則相對疲弱。在亞太地區，日本新訂單展現較強韌性，製造業預期強勁成長。澳洲則在10 月跌入萎縮區間後，需求顯露疲軟。
paras_en: After a turbulent swing in technology and artificial intelligence (AI) concept stocks and a market pull‑back, global financial markets face a data‑packed week. This week coincides with the US Thanksgiving holiday, shortening US market trading hours, and investors must digest a series of key macroeconomic data before the Thursday market close.

Key data include the inflation gauge most watched by the US Federal Reserve – the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index – and the revised Q3 GDP figure. At the same time, the Bank of Korea will hold a rate meeting, with markets broadly expecting it to resume its tightening cycle.
Weekly trading notes (Nov 22‑Nov 28)
The US economic data this week are concentrated on Tuesday and Wednesday, with the market’s primary focus on the October PCE price index.

According to forecasts, both the overall October PCE and core PCE month‑over‑month rates are expected to be about 0.3%, indicating that underlying price pressures remain resilient. If the data meet expectations, they will further support the Federal Open Market Committee’s stance of maintaining a restrictive monetary policy or a cautious approach in December.

On the income and consumption side, October personal income is projected to rise about 0.3% month‑over‑month, boosted by refunds of health‑insurance premiums and early disbursements of certain military benefits, while personal spending is expected to increase 0.4% month‑over‑month. In addition, the revised annualised Q3 GDP growth rate is forecast to stay in a solid 3.4%‑3.5% range, and October durable‑goods orders, supported by technology and aerospace capital spending, are expected to grow 0.5%.
On the other hand, the Thanksgiving Black Friday and Cyber Monday shopping season is about to begin, but analysts note that retailers’ discount power is markedly weaker this year.
South Korea Central Bank Rate Decision

Globally, the Bank of Korea (BOK) will hold its monetary policy meeting on Thursday. With October core CPI year‑over‑year holding at a relatively high 2.8%, Q3 GDP growth exceeding expectations, and AI‑driven strong semiconductor exports, markets anticipate the BOK will restart tightening, raising the policy rate by 25 basis points (one tick) to 3.25%.
European Central Bank Releases Meeting Minutes

The European Central Bank (ECB) will publish the minutes of its most recent monetary policy meeting on Thursday, where the decision was to keep the policy rate unchanged. In the meeting, the ECB warned that persistently high energy prices could further lift inflation and also dampen overall economic activity, expressing continued concern over secondary inflation pressures.

The minutes will reveal officials’ internal discussions on euro‑area growth momentum, slowing demand (as reflected by weak French and euro‑area PMI readings) and changes in supply‑chain costs, providing the market with key inputs for assessing the ECB’s future rate path.
Global PMI Review of Growth Momentum
Regarding macro data, a range of countries including the US, Europe, the UK, Japan and Australia will sequentially release the November S&P Global Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) flash numbers.

Manufacturing and services PMIs in the US and the UK are expected to continue expanding, while France and Germany show relatively weaker economic performance. In the Asia‑Pacific region, Japan’s new orders demonstrate strong resilience with robust manufacturing growth expectations. Australia, after slipping into contraction in October, is showing signs of weakening demand.

items.title: 股市穩定基金上膛！南韓祭出穩市三箭 嚴打非法放空三個月
items.title_en: Stock-Stabilization Fund Ready! South Korea Unleashes Three Arrows to Stabilize Market, Cracks Down on Illegal Short Selling for Three Months
paras: 南韓高層金融官員週日(22日)召開緊急會議後宣布，將分階段推動穩定市場措施，包括確保股市穩定基金隨時待命，以因應市場波動加劇。
南韓財長李炯日、南韓央行(BOK)總裁申鉉松及金融委員會、金融監督院首長共同出席，研商美股拋售的連鎖效應，並擬定應變方案。BOK下週四(26日)將召開貨幣政策會議，經濟學家預估將升息1碼。
根據聯合聲明，當局將立即籌備股市穩定基金以備不時之需。為緩解波動，將放寬上市企業每日庫藏股買回上限，為期三個月；同時對非法放空實施三個月特別強化監控，一經查獲將「嚴厲處置」。
官員指出，AI與晶片產業不確定性升高，使內外股市波動明顯加劇，但強調「AI產業長期成長預期依然穩固，須防過度焦慮或恐慌性拋售」。
會議召開前，南韓股市上週五(20日)再度大幅下挫，KOSPI重挫5.2%，收在10個月低點，KOSDAQ指數亦跌逾5%，KOSPI收4869.96點，跌267.93點、跌幅5.21%，時隔3個交易日再度失守5000點關卡。
南韓股市被視為AI投資風向球，隨著市場對估值與負債攀升疑慮加深，投資人紛紛撤離。
paras_en: South Korean senior financial officials held an emergency meeting on Sunday (22) and announced phased market‑stabilization measures, including keeping a stock‑market stabilization fund on standby to respond to heightened volatility.

Finance Minister Lee Kyoung‑il, Bank of Korea Governor Shin Hyun‑sung, and the heads of the Financial Services Commission and Financial Supervisory Service attended, discussing the chain reaction from U.S. equity sell‑offs and drafting response plans. The BOK will hold a monetary‑policy meeting next Thursday (26); economists expect a one‑tick rate hike.

According to the joint statement, authorities will immediately set up a stock‑market stabilization fund for emergencies. To ease volatility, the daily limit on share‑repurchase buybacks by listed companies will be relaxed for three months; at the same time, illegal short‑selling will be subject to a three‑month special intensified monitoring, with any violations to be dealt with severely.

Officials noted that uncertainty in the AI and semiconductor sectors has increased volatility in both domestic and foreign markets, but emphasized that the long‑term growth outlook for the AI industry remains solid and that investors should avoid excessive anxiety or panic selling.

Before the meeting, the South Korean market fell sharply again on Friday (20); the KOSPI plunged 5.2% to a ten‑month low, the KOSDAQ also dropped more than 5%, with the KOSPI closing at 4,869.96 points, down 267.93 points or 5.21%, breaking the 5,000‑point barrier for the first time in three trading days.
The South Korean market is viewed as a bellwether for AI investment; as concerns over valuations and rising debt deepen, investors are withdrawing their funds.

items.title: 歐盟擬向科技巨頭課徵3%數位稅 2.04兆歐元預算修訂案引發法德分歧
items.title_en: EU Plans 3% Digital Tax on Tech Giants, 2.04 Trillion‑Euro Budget Revision Sparks France‑Germany Rift
paras: 歐洲理事會主席科斯塔(Antonio Costa)周六(21日)提出歐盟 2028 至 2034 年長期預算(MFF)最新修訂草案。為了減輕各國直接財政負擔，科斯塔主張向全球大型科技企業課徵 3% 數位服務稅，並同步開徵電子廢棄物稅與提高菸草稅。
然而，新草案將歐盟執委會(European Commission)原先規劃的預算大砍 2,040 億歐元，引發法國與德國等核心成員國在「削減支出」與「維持產業與農業補貼」上的強烈對立。

課徵3%數位稅

科斯塔本次提出的全新收入管道，核心在於建立歐盟的「自有資源」，用以補足財政缺口並降低成員國的年度撥款壓力。根據草案內容，數位服務稅將鎖定雙重門檻企業：在歐盟境內年度數位業務營收達 5,000 萬歐元以上，且全球年度總營收超過 7.5 億歐元的大型科技巨頭。
符合標準的企業，需就其在歐盟境內的線上廣告、數位中介服務以及使用者生成數據等業務，按年度淨營業額的 3% 繳納稅款。
此外，歐盟計畫針對電子廢棄物徵稅、調高菸草稅，並探索加密資產稅與無線電頻譜拍賣收益。歐盟理事會估算，這些新開闢的自有資源每年可帶來約 600 億歐元的進帳。
針對外界疑慮，科斯塔特別強調：「這項稅收絕非針對任何特定公司或國家。」不過外界普遍認為，此舉恐將引發美國總統川普政府的強烈反彈。

成員國陣營強烈對立

儘管科斯塔對草案寄予厚望，宣稱「我相信這項提案能讓我們更接近最終協議」，但修訂草案一出，隨即遭到節儉派成員國與農業支持派雙向夾擊。
以德國為首的節儉派國家認為預算規模依然過重。德國總理梅爾茨(Friedrich Merz)直言，預算的「整體規模依然過高」，並強調「幾乎所有成員國」都必須在國內進行財政整頓。瑞典歐洲事務部長羅森克蘭茨(Jessica Rosencrantz)在社群媒體 X 上警示：「我們距離達成妥協還有很長一段路要走。」主張歐盟應將重點放在削減支出與減輕各國出資負擔上。
身為歐盟第二大經濟體及淨出資國的法國，則強烈反對過度削減預算。法國總統馬克宏(Emmanuel Macron)辦公室發表聲明，批評提案「令人深感失望」，特別是在共同農業政策(CAP)與農民收入支持方面遠低於需求，強調「就目前而言，歐洲理事會主席的這份提案無法做為達成協議的基礎」。
這份修訂草案將成為下周布魯塞爾歐盟領袖峰會的交鋒焦點。科斯塔極力爭取在 2026 年 12 月底前達成共識，主因是擔心談判若拖延至 2027 年，隨著法國等地將迎來大選，疑歐派政黨的崛起可能讓未來協商更難達成共識。
paras_en: EU Council President Antonio Costa on Saturday (the 21st) presented the latest revision of the EU’s 2028‑2034 long‑term budget (MFF). To ease the direct fiscal burden on member states, Costa proposes a 3% digital services tax on large global tech firms, alongside new e‑waste and higher tobacco taxes.

However, the new draft slashes the European Commission’s original budget by €204 billion, sparking a sharp clash between core members such as France and Germany over “spending cuts” versus “maintaining industry and agricultural subsidies.”

A 3% Digital Tax
Costa’s new revenue stream aims to create an EU “own resource” to fill fiscal gaps and reduce annual allocations to member states. Under the draft, the digital services tax will target firms that meet a dual threshold: annual digital revenues of at least €50 million within the EU and total worldwide annual turnover exceeding €750 million.
Qualifying companies must pay 3% of their net annual turnover derived from online advertising, digital intermediary services and user‑generated data within the EU.

In addition, the EU plans to levy a tax on e‑waste, raise tobacco duties, and explore taxes on crypto assets and revenues from radio‑spectrum auctions. The Council estimates these new own‑resource streams could generate roughly €60 billion a year.

Addressing external concerns, Costa stressed, “This tax is not aimed at any specific company or country.” Nonetheless, observers widely expect a strong backlash from the United States under President Trump’s administration.

Member‑State Camps Clash
Although Costa is optimistic, saying “I believe this proposal brings us closer to a final agreement,” the revised draft was immediately caught between fiscally‑conservative states and those backing agricultural support.

Led by Germany, the fiscally‑conservative bloc argues the budget remains too large. German Chancellor Friedrich Merz bluntly said the “overall size is still too high” and stressed that “almost all member states” must tighten domestic finances. Sweden’s European Affairs Minister Jessica Rosencrantz warned on X that “we have a long way to go before reaching a compromise,” urging the EU to focus on cutting spending and easing national contributions.

France, the EU’s second‑largest economy and net contributor, strongly opposes deep cuts. President Emmanuel Macron’s office issued a statement calling the proposal “deeply disappointing,” especially on the Common Agricultural Policy and farmer income support, and stressed that “as it stands, the Council President’s proposal cannot serve as a basis for an agreement.”

The revised draft will be the focal point of next week’s EU leaders summit in Brussels. Costa is pushing to secure a consensus by the end of December 2026, fearing that delays into 2027 could coincide with elections in France and elsewhere, potentially empowering Eurosceptic parties and making future negotiations even harder.

items.title: 華爾街日報：民主黨擬定針對川普調查重點 白宮批政治騙局拒配合
items.title_en: Wall Street Journal: Democrats Draft Investigation Focus on Trump; White House Calls It a Political Scam and Refuses to Cooperate
paras: 據《華爾街日報》報導，預計接任美國眾議院監督委員會主席的加州民主黨聯邦眾議員賈西亞(Robert Garcia)，日前向前總統川普家族及政府官員發出12封保存紀錄通知信，預告民主黨在明年新一屆國會取得傳票權後將發動密集調查。
賈西亞公開宣示：「這僅僅是個開始。」
民主黨擬定的調查重點鎖定四大領域：

一、家族商業利益：信中指控小唐納·川普(Donald Trump Jr.)與埃里克·川普(Eric Trump)利用家族加密貨幣企業 World Liberty Financial 謀利。對此，該公司發言人反駁調查是「毫無根據的政治迫害」，強調公司符合所有法律。此外，川普女婿庫許納(Jared Kushner)收取的高額費用與前大使Kimberly Guilfoyle涉嫌索費事宜，也遭質疑為變相酬金。
二、移民執法疑雲：前國土安全部長Kristi Noem被控將合約頒給捐款者；前特別雇員Corey Lewandowski則遭指向私營拘留所業者索酬，其發言人回應稱賈西亞編造誤導說法，「將在適當場合證明是錯誤的」。前幕僚長米勒推行逮捕配額與大搜捕亦受調查。
三、白宮建設與愛潑斯坦案：民主黨關注耗資逾6億美元的白宮新宴會廳建設，質疑半導體巨頭輝達在獲准售晶片後捐款的動機。愛潑斯坦案方面，賈西亞要求副總統范斯與前幕僚長威爾斯提供會議紀錄，質疑政府保護川普；司法部長Todd Blanche則否認Ghislaine Maxwell獲得移監優待，強調因生命安全威脅才轉移。
四、白宮強烈反擊：白宮發言人Lauren Bis直斥調查純屬「騙局」。白宮法律顧問Will Scharf致信表明政府絕不配合少數黨要求，並警告賈西亞，缺乏正當立法目的的調查恐「越界構成公然的犯罪行為」。兩黨國會監督角力即將全面升溫。
paras_en: According to the Wall Street Journal, Robert Garcia, a Democratic U.S. Representative from California who is expected to become chair of the House Oversight Committee, recently sent 12 preservation‑notice letters to members of the Trump family and government officials, warning that Democrats will launch an intensive investigation once the new Congress gains subpoena power next year.
Garcia publicly declared, “This is just the beginning.”
The Democrats’ proposed investigation targets four major areas:

1. Family business interests: The letters allege that Donald Trump Jr. and Eric Trump profited from the family’s cryptocurrency venture, World Liberty Financial. A company spokesperson dismissed the probe as “baseless political persecution,” insisting the firm complies with all laws. The high fees paid to Jared Kushner and alleged fee‑seeking by former ambassador Kimberly Guilfoyle are also being questioned as disguised compensation.

2. Immigration‑enforcement concerns: Former Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem is accused of awarding contracts to donors; former special employee Corey Lewandowski is alleged to have solicited payments from private detention‑facility operators, with his spokesperson saying Garcia fabricated misleading statements that “will be proven wrong at the appropriate time.” Former chief of staff Miller’s arrest‑quota program and large‑scale raids are also under scrutiny.

3. White House construction and the Epstein case: Democrats are focusing on the more than $600 million new White House banquet hall, questioning the motives of semiconductor giant Nvidia after it was allowed to sell chips following a donation. In the Epstein matter, Garcia has asked Vice President Kamala Harris and former chief of staff William Wells for meeting minutes, alleging government protection of Trump; Attorney General Todd Blanche denied that Ghislaine Maxwell received preferential treatment in prison, emphasizing that a transfer was made due to safety threats.

4. White House strong rebuttal: White House spokesperson Lauren Bis labeled the investigation a “scam.” White House legal counsel Will Scharf wrote that the administration will not cooperate with the minority party’s request and warned Garcia that an investigation lacking a legitimate legislative purpose could “overstep and constitute an outright criminal act.” The partisan battle over congressional oversight is set to heat up.

items.title: 韓股暴跌 散戶已無現金攤平！26兆韓元融資面臨斷頭風暴
items.title_en: Korean Stocks Plunge, Retail Investors Run Out of Cash to Average Down! 26 Trillion Won Margin Debt Faces Liquidation Storm
paras: 南韓股市重挫之際，散戶投資人正面臨資金告罄與斷頭平倉的雙重危機。南韓KOSPI指數周五(20日)大跌5.21%，收在4,869.96點，失守4,900點大關；KOSDAQ指數下挫5.71%。半導體巨頭三星電子與SK海力士分別重挫7.01%與5.92%，雙雙觸發邊車(Sidecar)暫停交易機制。
當日外資與機構法人在KOSPI各自賣超約1兆韓元，散戶雖逆勢逢低接刀，在兩大市場合計買超1.8184兆韓元(KOSPI買超1.5381兆韓元、KOSDAQ買超2,803億韓元)，但後續逢低加碼攤平的「子彈」已急劇枯竭。
據南韓金融投資協會(KOFIA)最新統計，截至19日，南韓證券市場的投資人備用資金(客戶保證金)降至81.5669兆韓元，相較於12日的92.2347兆韓元，短短一周內大幅蒸發10.6678兆韓元(減幅達11.57%)，相當於平均每天有1.52兆韓元資金離開市場。
《Financial News》報導，投資人在股市下跌初期，通常會動用閒置資金與帳戶餘額逢低攤平，但當市場暴跌成為常態，資金便會消耗殆盡，「無論股票看起來多麼便宜，沒有子彈就無法扣動扳機」，這顯示市場隨時可用於加碼的後備火力已嚴重受創。
比資金乾涸更令人擔憂的，是高高掛起的槓桿融資餘額。截至19日，韓股融資貸款餘額仍高達26.0832兆韓元(KOSPI占20.2068兆韓元，KOSDAQ占5.8764兆韓元)，未結算應收帳款達9,700億韓元。
散戶用自有資金買股還能忍受虧損等待反彈，但融資買股無法等待，分析師估算，若投資人以500萬韓元本金搭配500萬韓元融資買進股票，當股價下跌30%時，本金即遭吞噬60%。一旦維持率跌破門檻，券商將展開強制平倉(斷頭)，高達26兆韓元的融資餘額，恐演變成「股價下跌觸發斷頭、斷頭賣壓再壓低股價」的連鎖惡性循環。
雪上加霜的是，韓股20日收盤後，美股爆發重挫海嘯，那斯達克指數大跌5.13%，費城半導體指數崩跌逾10%，AI龍頭輝達單日暴跌14.01%，這使得23日(周一)開盤將是對南韓股市資金承載能力與市場供需極限的嚴峻考驗。
paras_en: South Korea’s stock market suffered a sharp decline, leaving retail investors facing a double crisis of depleted cash and forced liquidation. The KOSPI index fell 5.21% on Friday (the 20th), closing at 4,869.96 points and slipping below the 4,900‑point threshold; the KOSDAQ index dropped 5.71%. Semiconductor giants Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix slid 7.01% and 5.92% respectively, both triggering the Sidecar trading‑halt mechanism.

On the same day, foreign and institutional investors sold roughly 1 trillion won each on the KOSPI. Retail investors, buying the dip against the trend, net‑bought 1.8184 trillion won across the two markets (1.5381 trillion won on the KOSPI and 280.3 billion won on the KOSDAQ), but the “bullets” they hoped to use for further averaging down have rapidly run out.

According to the latest figures from the Korea Financial Investment Association (KOFIA), as of the 19th the reserve funds (client margin) in South Korea’s securities market fell to 81.5669 trillion won, down from 92.2347 trillion won on the 12th – a sharp evaporation of 10.6678 trillion won (11.57%) in just one week, equivalent to an average daily outflow of about 1.52 trillion won.

Financial News reported that investors typically dip into idle cash and account balances to average down when a market first falls, but when sharp declines become the norm, those funds are exhausted. “No matter how cheap a stock looks, without bullets you can’t pull the trigger,” the article said, indicating that the market’s backup firepower for additional buying has been severely damaged.

Even more concerning than the cash shortage is the towering leveraged‑margin balance. As of the 19th, margin loans on Korean stocks remained at a staggering 26.0832 trillion won (20.2068 trillion won on the KOSPI and 5.8764 trillion won on the KOSDAQ), with unsettled receivables amounting to 970 billion won.

Retail investors can endure losses with their own capital while waiting for a rebound, but those who bought on margin cannot. Analysts estimate that if an investor uses 5 million won of own money matched with 5 million won of borrowed funds to purchase a stock, a 30% price drop would wipe out 60% of the equity. Once the maintenance margin falls below the required level, brokers will trigger forced liquidations. The 26 trillion won of outstanding margin could spark a vicious chain reaction: falling prices trigger liquidations, which add sell pressure and push prices even lower.

To make matters worse, after the Korean market closed on the 20th, U.S. equities suffered a severe sell‑off. The Nasdaq plunged 5.13%, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell more than 10%, and AI leader Nvidia tumbled 14.01% in a single day. This sets up a harsh test on Monday the 23rd for the South Korean market’s capacity to absorb capital and its supply‑demand limits.

items.title: 比特幣崩了！5.5萬美元背後 加密市場發生了什麼？
items.title_en: Bitcoin Crashed! What’s Happening in the Crypto Market Behind the $55,000?
paras: 在美股崩跌的背景下，比特幣也遭遇強勁的拋售賣壓，並跌破 6 萬美元心理關卡，一度下探至 55,251.60 美元，創下自 2024 年 9 月以來的新低。根據《路透》報導，比特幣隨後雖短暫重回 6 萬美元上方，但市場避險情緒依然高漲。
回顧整體走勢，比特幣自 2025 年 10 月創下逾 12.6 萬美元的高點後便進入調整期，2026 年 11 月的這波拋售幾乎完全回吐了同年前期從 5.77 萬美元反彈至 8 萬美元的漲幅。
市場分析指出，本輪加密市場的回檔並非源於單一交易所危機或大型項目崩盤，而是全球風險資產的同步調整。《路透》分析認為，全球投資人對人工智慧(AI)基礎設施巨額投入能否轉化為實際盈利產生疑慮，導致科技股估值面臨修正壓力；而比特幣在實際交易中仍高度被視為高風險資產，因而與科技股同步承壓。
此外，美國借貸成本上升、實質殖利率走高以及美元走強，加上市場對美國聯準會(Fed)未來貨幣政策路徑的疑慮，共同促使資本轉向低風險資產。
機構資金的動向進一步加劇了市場下行壓力。根據 CoinDesk 報導，貝萊德(BlackRock)旗下的 iShares 比特幣信託(IBIT)在統計時段內錄得 5.411 億美元的單日淨流出，創下該基金成立以來的最大單日資金流出紀錄。
在衍生品市場方面，CoinDesk 數據顯示清算規模達數億美元，後續相關統計更顯示 24 小時內加密衍生品爆倉金額高達約 24 億美元，其中做多倉位遭受集中清算。價格下挫引發保證金不足與強制平倉，賣壓循環加速了槓桿去化進程。
隨著比特幣跌破先前夏末約 5.77 萬美元的支撐區間，市場對於加密牛市是否終結出現顯著分歧。部分觀點認為上漲周期已經結束，市場正轉入漫長熊市；另一派觀點則主張，此波回檔屬於總體流動性收緊與槓桿清算引發的深度調整，長期邏輯並未毀壞。
分析師指出，要判斷市場是否全面轉熊，仍需觀察數項核心指標：首先是比特幣現貨 ETF 能否恢復持續性淨流入；其次為衍生品槓桿清算是否趨緩並由現貨買盤接手；最後則是美聯準會貨幣政策與總體流動性是否改善。
paras_en: Against the backdrop of a U.S. stock market plunge, Bitcoin also faced strong selling pressure, slipping below the psychological $60,000 barrier and briefly dipping to $55,251.60, a new low since September 2024. Reuters reported that Bitcoin briefly rebounded above $60,000, but hedging sentiment in the market remained high.

Looking back at the overall trend, Bitcoin peaked at over $126,000 in October 2025 and entered a correction phase. The November 2026 sell‑off has almost completely erased the gains from the earlier rebound that lifted Bitcoin from $57,700 to $80,000 earlier this year.

Market analysts note that this crypto pullback is not driven by a single exchange crisis or a major project collapse, but by a synchronized adjustment of global risk assets. Reuters analysis suggests investors are questioning whether massive AI‑infrastructure spending will translate into real profits, putting pressure on tech‑stock valuations; meanwhile Bitcoin is still viewed as a high‑risk asset in actual trading, so it is bearing pressure alongside tech stocks.
In addition, rising U.S. borrowing costs, higher real yields, a stronger dollar, and doubts about the Federal Reserve’s future policy path have collectively pushed capital toward low‑risk assets.

Institutional fund flows have further amplified the downward pressure. According to CoinDesk, BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) recorded a single‑day net outflow of $541.1 million during the reporting period, the largest daily outflow since the fund’s inception.

In the derivatives market, CoinDesk data show liquidation volumes reaching several hundred million dollars, with 24‑hour crypto‑derivative forced‑liquidation amounts hitting roughly $2.4 billion, primarily affecting long positions. The price drop triggered margin calls and forced liquidations, accelerating the deleveraging cycle.

As Bitcoin fell below the late‑summer support zone around $57,700, the market showed a clear split on whether the crypto bull run is over. Some view the up‑cycle as finished and the market entering a prolonged bear market; others argue the pullback reflects a deep correction caused by tighter overall liquidity and leveraged liquidations, without destroying the long‑term thesis.

Analysts say that to determine whether the market has fully turned bearish, several core indicators must be watched: first, whether spot Bitcoin ETFs can resume sustained net inflows; second, whether leveraged derivatives liquidations are easing and being taken over by spot buying; and finally, whether Fed monetary policy and overall liquidity improve.

items.title: 〈台股風向球〉連環套賣壓需時間換空間 長期投資人心態先穩住
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Outlook: Sequential Selling Pressure Needs Time to Create Space; Long-Term Investors Should Keep Calm
paras: 台股過去一周湧出連鎖多殺多賣壓，共爆挫7641點、跌幅高達17.5%，金管會實施全面限空令，且上周五台積電最後一盤也湧現超過1萬張的買單，顯示國家隊全力護盤的意念，不過，法人提醒，上周五美股重挫令台股本周空頭巨浪持續席捲，融資斷頭恐全面殺出，籌碼要沉澱短期非易事，「長期投資人時間換取空間，個人心態先穩住」。
上周五台股爆發逃命賣壓，緊接著美股又重挫，法人不諱言，這波大盤修正恐比過去影響範圍更廣的原因在於─更多小資散戶「在船上」；由於對AI發展趨勢的強勁信心使拉回就有低接買盤，反而在現階段形成上檔重重連環套，而先無論投資金額大小，負面感受恐較以往更深刻，不過，內資已紛紛給出正向的鼓舞。
元大投顧分析，最新美銀美林基金經理人調查報告顯示，華爾街大砍科技股力道創20 年新高，反映 AI 投資帶進的收入難跟上資本支出投入速度，加上民主黨勝選後資料中心建置可能延宕或受限，造成股市本益比壓縮，因此，台股從逼近5萬點的 22 倍本益比，逐步下跌到 16.5倍本益比，重新回到過去合理區間 14-18 倍本益比當中。
不過，因調整仍在持續，布局上仍以降低槓桿與持股水位為優先，建議在行情未正式出現轉機訊息前勿貿然攤平。
永豐投顧分析，金管會祭出新的限空措施，使台股空方力道受到抑制，有助市場提早尋求短期平衡點，但因相關措施不利市場流動性，建議先觀望等待。
由於此次大盤重挫是涉及AI產業資本支出和CSP擴張策略調整，與過去單純因高槓桿操作所造成的修正有所不同，提防貿然搶反彈的風險。
短線先觀察美國國會已邀請黃仁勳在12月1日出席國會聽證，因聽證結果具高度不確定性，若聽證結果侷限於個人私德，或許對輝達影響有限，若是牽涉到晶片出口是否合規，則牽涉範圍廣泛。
paras_en: The Taiwan stock market saw a cascade of selling pressure over the past week, wiping out 7,641 points and a drop of up to 17.5%. The Financial Supervisory Commission imposed a comprehensive short‑selling ban, and on Friday the last session of TSMC saw more than 10,000 buy orders, indicating the state’s full‑scale market‑support effort. However, institutions warned that Friday’s sharp decline in U.S. equities would keep a wave of short‑selling rolling over Taiwan stocks this week, with margin calls potentially triggering a broad sell‑off. It will not be easy for capital to settle in the short term; long‑term investors should use time to regain space and keep their mindset steady.

On Friday the Taiwan market erupted with panic selling, followed immediately by a further plunge in U.S. markets. Institutions did not hide the fact that this correction could be broader than previous ones because more small‑investor retail participants are “on board.” Strong confidence in AI trends created low‑price buying when the market pulled back, but at the current level the market is hitting multiple resistance layers, and negative sentiment feels deeper than before regardless of investment size. Nevertheless, domestic investors are beginning to voice optimism.

Yuanta Securities analysis cites the latest Bank of America Merrill Lynch fund‑manager survey, which shows Wall Street’s massive cuts to tech stocks hitting a 20‑year high. This reflects that AI‑driven revenue growth cannot keep pace with capital‑expenditure outlays, and that after the Democratic victory data‑center build‑outs may be delayed or constrained, compressing market P/E ratios. Consequently, Taiwan’s P/E has fallen from a peak of about 22× near the 50,000‑point level to roughly 16.5×, returning to a historically reasonable range of 14‑18×.

However, because the adjustment is still ongoing, the priority in portfolio construction remains reducing leverage and lowering position sizes. It is advised not to flatten positions rashly before clear signs of a market turnaround emerge.

Yongfeng Securities analysis notes that the Financial Supervisory Commission’s new short‑selling restrictions have dampened bearish pressure, helping the market seek a short‑term balance point earlier. Yet, because the measures may hurt market liquidity, the recommendation is to adopt a wait‑and‑see stance.

The current market plunge is tied to AI‑industry capital spending and CSP expansion‑strategy adjustments, which differ from past corrections driven solely by high leverage. Investors should guard against the risk of jumping in prematurely on a rebound.

In the short term, watch the U.S. Congress hearing scheduled for December 1, where Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has been invited. The outcome is highly uncertain: if the hearing focuses only on personal conduct, the impact on Nvidia may be limited; if it addresses the compliance of chip exports, the ramifications could be far‑reaching.

paras: 在低軌衛星(LEO)市場需求持續湧現之下，包括HDI大廠華通(2313-TW)及微波通訊元件廠昇達科(3491-TW)，2026年以來的獲利走揚，且都決議再進行市場籌資支應進一步的營運擴充，兩者合計以發行可轉換公司債(CB)籌資達200億元。
華通2026年前三季稅後純益51.83億元，年增20.52%，每股純益達4.31元。華通並將在市場發行可轉換公司債(CB)籌資合計180億元。
華通在今年第三季以辦理現增以發行 4.2 萬張現增股完成籌資 86.1 億元，成華通歷來最大規模籌資案後，華通董事會再決議以發行無擔保可轉換公司債(CB)再籌資180億元。
華通的籌資案，主要因預估因應全球客戶對AI資料中心基礎設施及新世代低軌衛星(LEO產品的強勁需求，公司積極調整產品結構並擴大國內外產能布局，規劃2026-2028年，連續三年資本支出均維持在200億元以上的高檔水位。因此，繼今年第三季辦理現增以發行 4.2 萬張現增股籌資案完成籌資 86.1 億元，成華通歷來最大規模籌資案後，今天華通董事會再決議以發行無擔保可轉換公司債再籌資180億元。

PCB相關業者分析，低軌道衛星產業從現在到2027年上半年，將面臨Starship星艦V3火箭的升級換代交替期，當新世代火箭發射頻率增加，就可以判斷V3及D2C衛星很快地會進入穩定部署階段，全球低軌道衛星產業鏈將進入另一階段的加速成長。華通很早就投入太空PCB板研發與生產，與主要客戶合作10年，目前太空PCB板也由華通囊括大部分的市場份額，如果未來軌道運算成為事實，更將徹底顛覆大家對於太空產業的想像。
華通最新的獲利資訊方面，2026年第三季營收225.85億元，毛利率21.33%，季增2.82個百分點，年增1.38個百分點，2026年第三季稅後純益22億元，季增48.477%，年增2.06%，每股純益爲1.8元。華通2026年前3季營收621.65億元，毛利率19.36%，年增1.82個百分點，2026年前三季稅後純益51.83億元，年增20.52%，每股純益達4.31元。
微波通訊元件廠昇達科2026年1-9月稅後純益8.12億元，年增1.69倍，每股純益達11.86元，昇達科董事會也決議發行20億元的發行無擔保可轉換公司債進行籌資。
低軌衛星仍是推升昇達科營運成長的主要引擎，隨著既有客戶衛星部署規模持續擴大，公司相關毫米波通訊產品出貨同步成長，動能持續擴增。
同時，昇達科的重點客戶新一代產品認證進展順利，也意味昇達科不僅受惠既有世代產品放量，也持續跟進客戶下一世代衛星架構與產品升級，有利於延續後續產品生命周期及訂單能見度。
paras_en: Amid the continued surge in demand for low‑earth‑orbit (LEO) satellites, major HDI supplier Hua‑Tong (2313‑TW) and microwave communication component maker Sheng‑Da‑Ke (3491‑TW) have both seen profits rise since 2026 and have decided to raise additional capital for further operational expansion, together issuing convertible bonds (CB) to raise a total of NT$20 billion.

Hua‑Tong posted a net profit after tax of NT$5.183 billion for the first three quarters of 2026, up 20.52% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$4.31, and will raise NT$18 billion through a market issuance of convertible bonds.

In the third quarter of this year, Hua‑Tong completed a cash‑increase offering of 42,000 new shares, raising NT$8.61 billion—the largest fundraising in its history—and the board subsequently approved an additional unsecured convertible bond issuance to raise NT$18 billion.

The fundraising is driven by the company’s forecast of strong demand from global AI data‑center infrastructure and next‑generation LEO satellite products. Hua‑Tong is reshaping its product mix and expanding capacity domestically and abroad, planning capital expenditures of over NT$20 billion per year from 2026‑2028. After the cash‑increase that raised NT$8.61 billion, the board today approved the unsecured convertible bond issuance for another NT$18 billion.

PCB analysts note that the LEO satellite industry will, from now until the first half of 2027, go through a transition as SpaceX’s Starship V3 rockets are upgraded. Increased launch frequency of the next‑generation rockets will push V3 and D2C satellites into a stable deployment phase, accelerating growth across the global LEO supply chain. Hua‑Tong has long been involved in space‑grade PCB R&D and production, partnering with key customers for a decade and now commanding most of the market share; if orbital computing becomes a reality, it could fundamentally reshape the space industry.

Regarding its latest profitability, Hua‑Tong reported Q3 2026 revenue of NT$22.585 billion, a gross margin of 21.33% (up 2.82 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 1.38 points year‑over‑year). Net profit after tax was NT$2.2 billion, up 48.477% quarter‑over‑quarter and 2.06% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$1.80. For the first three quarters of 2026, revenue totaled NT$62.165 billion, gross margin was 19.36% (up 1.82 points YoY), and net profit after tax was NT$5.183 billion, up 20.52% YoY, yielding EPS of NT$4.31.

Microwave component maker Sheng‑Da‑Ke posted a net profit after tax of NT$812 million for January‑September 2026, a 1.69‑fold year‑over‑year increase, with earnings per share of NT$11.86. Its board also approved the issuance of unsecured convertible bonds to raise NT$2 billion.

LEO satellites remain the main driver of Sheng‑Da‑Ke’s operational growth. As existing customers expand their satellite deployments, shipments of the company’s millimeter‑wave communication products grow in tandem, sustaining momentum.

Furthermore, the certification progress of next‑generation products for Sheng‑Da‑Ke’s key customers is proceeding smoothly, indicating that the company not only benefits from volume increases of current‑generation products but also continues to follow customers’ next‑generation satellite architectures and product upgrades, supporting the continuation of product lifecycles and order visibility.

items.title: AI進入重新定價 法人：聚焦四大止穩訊號 靜待籌碼沉澱後分批布局
items.title_en: AI Enters Re‑pricing Phase: Institutions Focus on Four Key Stabilisation Signals, Await Chip Settlement Before Staggered Positioning
paras: 台股近期遭遇劇烈修正，加權指數20日重挫近2400點，短短一周內累計跌幅超過17%，不僅跌破年線關卡，更引發市場對AI泡沫與高估值的擔憂。面對恐慌性賣壓與籌碼快速去槓桿，投資人該如何判斷市場何時止跌，安聯投信台股團隊點出，這波行情正從「題材驅動」轉向「獲利驗證」的關鍵轉折，提醒投資人後市必須緊盯四大止穩訊號，靜待籌碼沉澱後分批布局。
若從台股11月13日高點43,675.12點計算，短短一周內大盤跌幅已超過17%，市場風險偏好快速降溫。安聯投信台股團隊指出，此波急跌是美股修正、AI估值調整、外資調節與融資去槓桿等多重因素交互作用的結果。隨著大盤跌破年線，短線市場信心明顯受挫，目前台股正處於「基本面仍具支撐，但評價面與籌碼面快速修正」的階段。
安聯台灣大壩基金暨安聯台灣科技基金經理人蕭惠中分析，11月以來市場對AI投資的檢視標準大幅提高，包括資料中心監管、龐大資本支出的投資回報率，以及科技股高估值等議題均引發獲利了結賣壓。她強調，AI投資正從過去的「題材驅動」邁向「獲利驗證」，即使企業訂單持續成長，一旦市場下修未來本益比，股價仍會面臨劇烈調整。
不過，從基本面觀察，AI供應鏈需求尚未出現轉折。美國大型雲端服務業者資本支出依舊強勁，新一代Vera Rubin伺服器陸續出貨，預期台灣相關供應鏈第四季營收仍將延續成長，部分廠商季增幅甚至可達雙位數。蕭惠中指出，台灣在先進製程、封裝、散熱及高速傳輸等領域仍具關鍵地位，安聯團隊預估2027年台股企業獲利可望成長35%，基本面仍具中長期底氣。
面對短線劇烈震盪，安聯投信建議投資人密切觀察以下四大止穩訊號：

AI獲利預期是否下修： 觀察雲端大廠資本支出及伺服器訂單是否維持成長，確認本波修正僅為評價重估，而非基本面反轉。
大型權值股能否止穩： 20日台積電盤中一度跌破2,000元大關、聯發科跌幅近一成，權值股能否率先建立低檔支撐是止跌關鍵。
外資與融資籌碼改善： 留意「外資期現貨賣壓是否收斂」，以及「融資餘額與槓桿型ETF的去化進度」，判斷去槓桿是否接近尾聲。
市場風險偏好回溫： 觀察上漲家數是否增加、中小型股賣壓是否減輕，以及反彈能否擴散至非電族群。


展望後市，蕭惠中認為，短線籌碼仍需時間沉澱，與其猜測指數低點，不如緊盯企業獲利能見度。操作策略上，建議以具技術門檻與訂價能力的大型龍頭科技股為核心，並適度配置傳產等非AI族群以降低波動，靜待籌碼沉澱後分批布局。
paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market has recently suffered a sharp correction, with the weighted index plunging nearly 2,400 points on the 20th and losing more than 17% in just one week. The index not only fell below its annual moving average but also sparked concerns about an AI bubble and over‑valuation. Facing panic selling and rapid deleveraging of capital, investors wonder when the market will stop falling. Allianz Asset Management’s Taiwan equity team points out that this rally is shifting from a “theme‑driven” phase to a “profit‑validation” turning point, urging investors to closely monitor four key stabilisation signals and to wait for capital to settle before building positions in stages.

Counting from the November 13 peak of 43,675.12 points, the market has dropped over 17% in just a week, indicating a swift cooling of risk appetite. Allianz’s Taiwan team notes that the steep decline results from a combination of US equity corrections, AI valuation adjustments, foreign‑investor rebalancing and margin‑deleveraging. With the index breaking below its annual trend line, short‑term confidence has been clearly shaken, and Taiwan stocks are now in a phase where “fundamentals still provide support, but valuations and capital flows are being rapidly corrected.”

Allianz Taiwan Dam Fund and Allianz Taiwan Technology Fund manager Hsu Hui‑Chung explains that since November, the criteria for AI investments have tightened dramatically, covering data‑center regulation, massive capex return‑on‑investment expectations, and the high valuations of tech stocks, all of which have triggered profit‑taking pressure. She stresses that AI investment is moving from a “theme‑driven” approach to “profit validation”; even if corporate orders keep growing, a market downgrade of future P/E multiples will still cause sharp price adjustments.

Nevertheless, from a fundamentals perspective, demand in the AI supply chain has not turned. Major US cloud service providers continue to spend heavily on capital, and the next‑generation Vera Rubin servers are being shipped steadily. Revenue for Taiwan’s related supply chain is expected to keep growing in Q4, with some manufacturers posting double‑digit quarterly increases. Hsu notes that Taiwan remains pivotal in advanced processes, packaging, thermal management and high‑speed interconnects, and the Allianz team projects a 35% growth in Taiwanese corporate earnings by 2027, indicating solid medium‑ to long‑term fundamentals.
Facing short‑term volatility, Allianz Investment advises investors to closely watch the following four stabilisation signals:

• Whether AI profit expectations are being revised down: monitor if cloud giants’ capex and server orders remain on an upward trajectory to confirm that the current correction is a valuation re‑rating rather than a fundamental reversal.
• Whether large‑cap heavyweight stocks can stabilise: on the 20th, TSMC briefly fell below the NT$2,000 mark intraday and MediaTek dropped nearly 10%; the ability of heavyweight stocks to establish low‑level support is key to halting the decline.
• Improvement in foreign‑investor and margin‑fund flows: watch for a convergence of foreign investors’ spot‑future selling pressure and the pace at which margin balances and leveraged ETFs are being unwound, to gauge whether deleveraging is nearing its end.
• A warming of market risk appetite: observe whether the number of advancing stocks rises, whether selling pressure on mid‑ and small‑caps eases, and whether the rebound spreads beyond the semiconductor sector.

With drug approvals in Europe, the United States and Japan coming through one after another, plus large CDMO contracts and a surge in demand for premium contact lenses, a wave of re‑valuation is now under way.
New drug development is entering a harvest phase, with differentiated therapies targeting the global blue‑ocean market.

Taiwan's biotech drug industry is undergoing a second revolution. The operational focus has shifted from pure R&D to overseas regulatory approval and commercial monetisation. Several domestically based drug companies with international competitiveness are advancing drug‑approval reviews, obtaining market licences, or completing high‑value overseas licensing deals in major markets such as Europe, the United States and Japan, driving a noticeable uplift in the valuation of the whole sector.

The key to this wave of Taiwanese drug breakthroughs lies in precisely targeting unmet medical needs. By expanding into new indications and innovative dosage forms, companies are building market exclusivity. Whether extending an already‑approved orphan drug to a much larger patient pool, or using proprietary oral‑film technology to solve swallowing difficulties and capture the huge opportunity created by expiring brand‑name patents, the commercial value of the products has risen sharply. In addition, globally first‑in‑class oral and cell therapies for rare eye diseases and neuro‑degenerative disorders are now in the final stages of regulatory approval, showcasing Taiwanese firms' ability to compete in the multi‑billion‑dollar global market.
CDMO and premium contact‑lens demand are booming, with manufacturing and consumption advancing side by side.

Beyond the success of new‑drug R&D, the global trend toward outsourced pharmaceutical manufacturing (CDMO) and a rebound in Asian consumer markets are feeding the industry with a steady stream of cash. International pharma companies are accelerating the release of large‑molecule biologics and later‑stage production orders, pushing CDMO providers with cross‑border capacity footprints to record‑high order books. The contact‑lens segment benefits from renewed demand in China, Japan and the United States, and the high‑margin silicone‑hydrogel coloured lenses continue to gain market share.
