items.title: 車用照明與感測逐步撐腰台LED廠 雷笛克、光鋐出貨結構優化
items.title_en: Automotive Lighting and Sensing Gradually Support Taiwan LED Makers; Raytek and Guanghong Optimize Shipment Structure
paras: 隨著傳統消費性電子需求走弱，台灣LED產業近年積極調整產品結構並淡出低毛利市場，目前車用照明與顯示應用已逐步成為支撐台廠業績的核心支柱。其中光學透鏡廠雷笛克(5230-TW)受惠於多款車用照明新專案步入放量階段，第三季車用領域銷售創下歷年單季新高，占整體營收比重達44%，帶動單季毛利率重返三成大關並較去年同期轉虧為盈。
觀察雷笛克近期營運表現，受惠於頭燈應用占比提升與人工智能伺服器精密結構件出貨增溫，第三季合併營收達4.05億元、每股純益0.34元創近16季新高，10月合併營收更進一步攀升至1.43億元續寫單月歷史紀錄。雷笛克指出，國際車廠積極導入2.5萬畫素以上的Micro LED智慧頭燈，由於這類高解析模組對光束準直、聚光效率及熱變形控制要求大幅提高，將帶動高精度非球面透鏡與複合式光學模組的中長期成長動能。
同樣受惠於車用出貨成長的LED大廠艾笛森(3591-TW)，第三季合併營收達新台幣7.798億元、季增約一成三，單季毛利率也由第二季的平均兩成左右提升至約二成二。為強化集團垂直整合並加快新機種對接速度，艾笛森董事會已通過合資設立專業光學設計公司，短期內將優先把車用照明與高階照明的光學設計主導權拉回集團內部，並預期車用領域在今年第四季與明年仍將維持穩健成長態勢。
在磊晶與晶粒端布局方面，光鋐(4956-TW)近年將營運重心由傳統照明背光移轉至車用、感測與特殊照明，今年前三季感測與車用兩大應用合計已占整體營收近八成，其中車用占比達三成五、感測占比更由去年同期的三成九提升至四成三。透過持續降低傳統價格競爭激烈品項的比重，光鋐產品組合轉型成效已明顯反映在出貨結構上，並同步朝光通訊與短波紅外光等高值化領域擴充研發。
龍頭大廠富采(3714-TW)則在三加一發展策略下持續推進車用新產品導入，目前直下式分區點亮背光專案已順利量產並帶動車用顯示產品成長，後續也將推進新一階段的車用設計導入專案。儘管短期內受部分模組電子元件供應偏緊及消費性電子淡季影響，法人預期富采第四季營收將較第三季明顯下滑，但隨著車用、電視背光與智慧穿戴感測應用持續支撐營運，明年整體營收仍可望維持小幅成長。
paras_en: As traditional consumer electronics demand weakens, Taiwan's LED industry has been actively reshaping its product mix and exiting low‑margin markets in recent years. Automotive lighting and display applications are now gradually becoming the core pillar supporting Taiwanese manufacturers' performance. Optical lens maker Raytek (5230‑TW) benefits from several new automotive lighting projects entering volume production; its Q3 automotive sales hit a record single‑quarter high, accounting for 44% of total revenue, driving the quarterly gross margin back to the 30% level and turning a loss into profit year‑over‑year.

Looking at Raytek's recent operations, the rise in headlamp application share and increased shipments of precision AI server components lifted Q3 consolidated revenue to NT$405 million and earnings per share to NT$0.34, both near 16‑quarter highs. In October, consolidated revenue further rose to NT$143 million, setting a new monthly record. Raytek notes that international automakers are actively adopting Micro‑LED smart headlamps with over 25,000 pixels; these high‑resolution modules demand much tighter beam collimation, focusing efficiency and thermal‑deformation control, which will drive medium‑ to long‑term growth of high‑precision aspheric lenses and hybrid optical modules.

LED giant Aiden (3591‑TW), also benefiting from automotive shipment growth, posted Q3 consolidated revenue of NT$779.8 million, up about 13% sequentially, and its quarterly gross margin rose from roughly 20% in Q2 to about 22%. To strengthen vertical integration and speed up new model roll‑outs, Aiden’s board approved a joint‑venture to establish a professional optical design firm, which will initially bring the optical design of automotive and premium lighting back in‑house, and the company expects the automotive segment to maintain steady growth in Q4 and next year.

On the wafer and chip level, Guanghong (4956‑TW) has shifted its focus from traditional back‑light lighting to automotive, sensing and specialty lighting in recent years. In the first three quarters of this year, automotive and sensing together accounted for nearly 80% of total revenue, with automotive at 35% and sensing rising from 39% a year ago to 43%. By continuously reducing the share of highly price‑competitive traditional items, Guanghong’s product‑mix transformation is clearly reflected in its shipment structure, and it is simultaneously expanding R&D into high‑value areas such as optical communications and short‑wave infrared light.

Industry leader Fucai (3714‑TW) continues to push new automotive products under its “three‑plus‑one” development strategy. Its direct‑type partitioned back‑light project has successfully entered mass production, driving growth in automotive display products, and a next‑stage automotive design integration project is forthcoming. Although short‑term revenue may dip in Q4 due to tighter supply of some module electronic components and a seasonal slowdown in consumer electronics, analysts expect Fucai’s Q4 revenue to fall noticeably from Q3, yet continued support from automotive, TV back‑light and smart‑wear sensing applications should allow overall revenue to achieve modest growth next year.

items.title: 第三波救市來了！金管會：23日起全面禁平盤下放空、籲法人停止出借股票
items.title_en: The Third Wave of Market Support Is Here! Financial Supervisory Commission: Effective from the 23rd, a Full Ban on Short Selling Below Par Value and Urges Institutions to Stop Lending Shares
paras: 台股近期跌跌不休，單周累計重挫 7,641.83 點、跌幅達 17.5%，20日加權指數收在 36,033.29 點。為遏止市場非理性恐慌並維護交易秩序，金管會緊急宣布祭出第三波穩定股市措施，自 23日起實施「全面禁止平盤以下放空」等五大救市新制，盼能有效提振市場信心。
金管會指出，鑑於近期國內外政經情勢動盪，台股持續呈現大幅波動，為維持證券市場之秩序及穩定性，決定自 2026 年 11 月 23 日起再採行五項措施。

全面禁止平盤以下放空： 投資人融券賣出及借券賣出上市（櫃）股票及臺灣存託憑證（TDR），賣出價格一律不得低於前一營業日收盤價。惟證券商及期貨商因辦理業務之避險需求所為之融券及借券賣出，不在此限。
調高最低融券保證金成數： 上市及上櫃有價證券之最低融券保證金成數，由現行的 130% 調升至 150%，以拉高空方放空成本。
暫停受理認售權證發行： 暫停受理證券商申請發行認售權證上市（櫃）案件，減少衍生性商品市場的助跌力道。
鼓勵企業實施庫藏股並納入 ESG 評鑑： 鼓勵上市（櫃）公司適時買回庫藏股，凡於 115 年度第 4 季至 116 年第 1 季期間屆滿或執行完畢者，均可納入 115 年 ESG 評鑑指標得分，以激勵企業護盤意願。
請機構法人停止出借股票： 鼓勵金融機構等出借人暫停對外出借股票，並就已出借部分視契約約定提前召回或到期不再續借，從源頭縮減市場借券賣出的籌碼供給。


金管會強調，後續將持續密切關注國際金融情勢變化及國內資本市場狀況，適時動態調整相關穩定措施；同時也呼籲投資人應回歸基本面，依本身投資策略審慎投資、理性因應，切勿過度恐慌殺低。
paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market has been sliding continuously, with a weekly cumulative drop of 7,641.83 points, a 17.5% decline, and the weighted index closing at 36,033.29 points on the 20th. To curb irrational panic and maintain orderly trading, the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) urgently announced a third wave of stock‑market stabilisation measures, implementing five new rescue rules—including a full ban on short selling below the previous day’s closing price—starting on the 23rd, hoping to boost market confidence.

The FSC noted that, given recent domestic and international political and economic turbulence and the persistent large‑scale volatility of Taiwan’s equities, it will adopt five measures from November 23, 2026 onward to preserve market order and stability. The measures are: a complete prohibition on short selling below the prior day’s closing price (investors may not sell borrowed shares or TDRs at a price lower than the previous trading day’s close, except for broker‑dealt hedging transactions); raising the minimum margin for securities lending from the current 130% to 150% to increase short‑selling costs; suspending the acceptance of applications for listed or over‑the‑counter covered warrant issuances to reduce downward pressure from derivatives; encouraging companies to conduct share buy‑backs and count them toward ESG evaluations for the 2025‑2026 period; and urging institutional investors to stop lending shares, recalling or not renewing any outstanding loans per contract to cut the supply of borrowed shares at the source.

The FSC stressed that it will continue to closely monitor international financial developments and domestic capital‑market conditions, adjusting stabilisation measures dynamically as needed. It also called on investors to return to fundamentals, invest prudently according to their own strategies, respond rationally, and avoid excessive panic‑driven selling.

items.title: 台積電周線重挫15.8%！台股創36年最慘單周紀錄、美收緊AI晶片出口管制添壓
items.title_en: TSMC Weekly Drop of 15.8% Triggers 36‑Year‑Worst Single‑Week in Taiwan Market as U.S. Tightens AI Chip Export Controls
paras: 台積電(2330-TW) 股價周五（21日）走勢疲弱，台灣股市同步遭遇重挫，周線跌幅擴大至約17.5%，創下36年來最慘單周表現。美國收緊先進晶片出口管制，也為半導體類股增添壓力，投資人持續評估相關政策對產業的影響。
根據《Benzinga》報導，台股加權指數周五下跌6.23%，收在36,033點，本周累計下跌約17.5%，創下1990年以來最大單周跌幅。台積電周五下跌4.76%，全周跌幅達15.8%，大型半導體股隨大盤賣壓同步走弱。
此外，美國商務部針對向中國企業出租 AI 運算能力的海外資料中心，實施了更嚴格的出口管制。
美國工業與安全局（BIS）11月16日發布一項名為「因應先進半導體遠端存取」（Addressing Remote Access to Advanced Semiconductors）的臨時最終規則，並於11月19日生效。
這些修正進一步收緊先進晶片的遠端存取限制，將相關門檻調整至16奈米，並取消一項原有豁免條款。該條款原本允許晶圓代工廠透過認證，確認特定晶片的電晶體數量較低，藉此適用豁免。
本周出口管制議題也對在美國上市的科技股造成壓力，投資人正評估華府透過海外管道限制先進AI晶片取得途徑的相關措施。
與此同時，台積電ADR(TSM-US) 股價亦持續走低，跌至4月2日以來最低水準，與10月高點487.47美元相比，已出現明顯回檔。
回顧近期走勢，台積電股價6月30日曾觸及479美元，之後於7月29日回落至372.72美元，隨後反彈並在10月創下階段高點。不過，近期賣壓再度加重，股價已跌破200日移動平均線。
截至周五收盤，台積電ADR股價為318.71美元，不僅低於200日均線，也較20日均線392.34美元低約15.8%。周五成交量明顯放大，股價開盤報337.99美元，低於前一交易日收盤價352.09美元，盤中也未能重新站回該價位。
paras_en: TSMC (2330‑TW) saw its share price weaken on Friday (the 21st), and the Taiwan stock market suffered a simultaneous plunge, with the weekly decline expanding to about 17.5%, marking the worst single‑week performance in 36 years. The United States’ tightening of advanced chip export controls adds further pressure to semiconductor stocks, and investors continue to assess the policy’s impact on the industry.

According to Benzinga, the Taiwan Weighted Index fell 6.23% on Friday, closing at 36,033 points, and has dropped roughly 17.5% for the week, the largest weekly decline since 1990. TSMC fell 4.76% on Friday, delivering a full‑week loss of 15.8%, while other large semiconductor stocks weakened in line with the broader market sell‑off.
In addition, the U.S. Department of Commerce has imposed stricter export controls on overseas data centers that lease AI computing capacity to Chinese firms.
The U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) issued an interim final rule on November 16 titled “Addressing Remote Access to Advanced Semiconductors,” which took effect on November 19.

These amendments further tighten remote‑access restrictions on advanced chips, lowering the applicable threshold to 16 nm and eliminating an existing exemption. The exemption previously allowed foundry companies, through certification, to confirm that certain chips contained a low transistor count and thus qualify for the waiver.
The export‑control issue also weighed on U.S.-listed technology stocks this week, as investors evaluate Washington’s measures to limit the acquisition of advanced AI chips through overseas channels.
At the same time, TSMC’s ADR (TSM‑US) continued to slide, reaching its lowest level since April 2, and showing a noticeable pull‑back from the October peak of $487.47.

Looking back, TSMC’s share price hit $479 on June 30, fell to $372.72 on July 29, then rebounded to set a mid‑term high in October. However, renewed selling pressure has now pushed the price below its 200‑day moving average.

As of Friday’s close, TSMC’s ADR was trading at $318.71, not only below the 200‑day moving average but also about 15.8% lower than the 20‑day average of $392.34. Trading volume spiked on Friday; the stock opened at $337.99, down from the prior day’s close of $352.09, and never regained that level during the session.

items.title: 台股血崩7641點下周守住35000！國安基金急派「定心丸」喊話4大撐盤亮點
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Plummets 7,641 Points; Next Week Defends 35,000 Mark—National Security Fund Deploys “Calming Pill” Highlighting Four Support Points
paras: 輝達（NVDA-US）執行長黃仁勳辭任風暴與美國AI監管趨嚴等利空夾擊，台股本周狂瀉7641.83點，跌幅高達17.5%，終場收在36033.29點，下周正式面臨35000點整數關卡保衛戰。面對市場恐慌情緒升溫，國安基金表示已進場展開護盤任務，強調台灣經濟基本面創下多項歷史新高，點出四大撐盤亮點，呼籲股民保持信心、無須過度恐慌。
回顧這波股災背景，自輝達創辦人黃仁勳辭去執行長職務後，市場對後黃仁勳時代的AI產業營運展望產生高度疑慮，加上美國AI監管政策可能趨嚴、龐大資本支出投資效益及融資風險等變數交織，導致美股連日重挫並全面波及亞股。台股從上周五收盤的43675.12點一路下殺，16日單日暴跌2635.04點，20日再度重挫2393.6點，單周累計血崩逾7600點，創下1991年以來最大單周跌幅。
隨著加權指數昨日收在36033.29點，盤中更一度下探35959點低點，市場普遍預期台股下周將迎來嚴峻的35000點整數關卡保衛戰。面對指數劇烈修正與超過300家上市櫃公司打入跌停的恐慌氛圍，投資人擔憂融資斷頭與外資持續提款，紛紛關注國家隊護盤力道能否有效止跌回穩。
為安定市場軍心，國安基金主動對外說明最新護盤動態與總體經濟數據。國安基金指出，自115年11月6日召開臨時委員會議，授權執行秘書執行市場安定任務後，國家隊資金便已正式進場展開護盤操作，全力發揮穩定金融市場的功能，讓全台股民能夠安心面對短期波動。
在觀察籌碼面變化方面，國安基金分析，近期外資雖然連續多日對台股呈現賣超調節，但隨著護盤機制啟動與市場逐步消化非理性賣壓，外資賣超力道已漸趨收斂。國安基金強調，當前台股下跌主要受國際消息面與市場心理因素牽動，並非台灣產業競爭力出現結構性反轉，呼籲投資人切勿在恐慌中盲目殺低。
國安基金進一步列舉四大總經與產業數據，力證台股基本面依然強勁。首先是經濟成長表現亮眼，根據行政院主計總處公布最新預測，115年台灣經濟成長率高達11.05%，一舉創下近39年來新高紀錄；同時，9月景氣對策信號續亮紅燈，達成連續10個月紅燈的史上最長紀錄，顯示國內景氣動能充沛。
其次在外貿接單與出口表現上，今年累計至10月的外銷訂單金額高達9430億美元，較去年同期大幅成長58.6%，同期累計出口金額也達到7582.9億美元，年增率高達47.7%，兩項關鍵指標雙雙改寫歷史新高紀錄，反映全球對台灣科技與AI供應鏈的實質需求依舊熱絡。
此外，上市櫃公司基本面獲利同樣交出亮眼成績單。根據統計，10月全體上市櫃公司未加計金融保險業的單月營收達6.74兆元，累計今年前10月營收更已衝上56.89兆元，不僅持續改寫歷史新高，更提前超越去年全年的50.77兆元水準，展現企業強大的營運韌性。
展望後市，國安基金重申，台灣經濟基本面穩健且展望樂觀，後續將會同金管會等相關部會密切關注國際政經局勢與台股交易動態，並視市場情況適時採取必要穩市措施。國安基金最後呼籲廣大投資人保持信心，以理性態度看待台股短期震盪，穩健評估優質企業的長期投資價值。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang's resignation amid a storm of negative factors, including tightening U.S. AI regulations, sent Taiwan's stock market tumbling 7,641.83 points this week, a 17.5% drop, closing at 36,033.29 points and setting up a showdown next week to hold the 35,000 round‑number barrier. In response to rising market panic, the National Security Fund said it has entered the market to protect it, stressing that Taiwan’s economic fundamentals have reached several historic highs and pointing out four key support highlights, urging investors to stay confident and not overreact.

Looking back at the background of this market crash, after Nvidia founder Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO, doubts surged about the post‑Huang AI industry outlook, compounded by the prospect of stricter U.S. AI regulation, massive capital‑intensive investments and financing risks. These factors drove U.S. equities into a sharp decline that spilled over to Asian markets. Taiwan’s index fell from Friday’s close of 43,675.12 points, dropping 2,635.04 points on the 16th and another 2,393.6 points on the 20th, totaling a weekly plunge of over 7,600 points—the biggest one‑week fall since 1991.

With the weighted index closing yesterday at 36,033.29 points and briefly dipping to a low of 35,959 points intraday, the market broadly expects a tough battle next week to defend the 35,000 round‑number level. Amid the index’s sharp correction and more than 300 listed companies hitting daily limits, investors worry about margin calls and continued foreign‑capital outflows, closely watching whether the state‑backed “national team” can effectively halt the decline and stabilize the market.

To steady market sentiment, the National Security Fund proactively briefed the public on its latest market‑support actions and macroeconomic data. It noted that since the emergency committee meeting on November 6, 2026 (year 115 of the Republic), which authorized the executive secretary to carry out market‑stabilization tasks, state funds have formally entered the market to perform protective operations, fully leveraging their role in stabilizing the financial system so that all Taiwanese investors can face short‑term volatility with confidence.

Regarding capital flows, the fund observed that although foreign investors have posted consecutive days of net selling, the activation of the support mechanism and the market’s gradual absorption of irrational sell pressure have begun to curb the net‑selling force. The fund emphasized that the current decline is driven by international news and market psychology rather than a structural reversal of Taiwan’s industrial competitiveness, urging investors not to panic‑sell at low levels.

The fund further listed four macro‑economic and industry data points to prove that Taiwan’s fundamentals remain strong. First, economic growth is impressive: the Directorate‑General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics reported a 2026 growth rate of 11.05%, a 39‑year high. At the same time, the September economic‑policy signal remained red for the tenth consecutive month, the longest streak on record, indicating robust domestic economic momentum.

Second, in foreign trade, cumulative export orders through October reached US$943 billion, up 58.6% year‑over‑year, while cumulative export value hit US$758.29 billion, a 47.7% increase, both setting new historical highs and reflecting strong global demand for Taiwan’s technology and AI supply chains.

Third, listed companies’ profitability also posted strong results. In October, total revenue of all listed firms excluding financial and insurance sectors reached NT$6.74 trillion for the month, and cumulative revenue for the first ten months of the year rose to NT$56.89 trillion, surpassing the full‑year 2025 level of NT$50.77 trillion and setting new records, demonstrating robust corporate resilience.

Looking ahead, the National Security Fund reiterated that Taiwan’s economic fundamentals are solid and outlook optimistic. It will continue to work closely with the Financial Supervisory Commission and other agencies to monitor international political‑economic developments and market dynamics, taking timely stabilizing measures as needed. The fund’s final call is for investors to stay confident, assess short‑term volatility rationally, and prudently evaluate the long‑term investment value of quality companies.

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：美國10月PCE、Q3 GDP修正值及南韓央行利率決議
items.title_en: Weekly Trading Notes: US October PCE, Q3 GDP Revision and South Korea Central Bank Rate Decision
paras: 在經歷科技與人工智慧(AI)概念股劇烈震盪與市場拉回後，全球金融市場迎來數據緊湊的一週。本週適逢美國感恩節假期，美國市場交易時間縮短，投資人需在週四休市前消化一連串關鍵宏觀經濟數據。
關鍵數據包含美國聯準會(Fed)最關注的通膨指標——個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數，以及第三季GDP修正值。同時，南韓央行將召開利率會議，市場普遍預期其將重啟升息步伐。

本週操盤筆記 (1122-1128)

1.美國PCE通膨指標登場
本週美國經濟數據集中於週二與週三釋出。金融市場最關注的焦點為10月 PCE 物價指數。
根據機構預估，10月整體 PCE 與核心 PCE 物價指數月增率均約為 0.3%，反映底層物價壓力依然具有韌性。若數據符合預期，將進一步支持聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)在12月維持限制性貨幣政策或審慎調控的立場。
在消費與所得方面，10月個人所得受醫療保險保費退費及部分軍人福利提前發放等因素推升，月增率預估可達 0.3%；個人支出月增率則預估為 0.4%。此外，美國第三季 GDP 季增年率修正值預計維持在 3.4% 至 3.5% 的穩健水準，而10月耐久財訂單受科技與航太資本支出支持，預估成長 0.5%。
另一方面，感恩節黑色星期五與網路星期一購物季即將開跑，但分析指出，今年零售商的折扣力道顯著減弱。
2.南韓央行利率決議
在全球央行方面，南韓央行(BOK)將於週四召開貨幣政策會議。由於南韓10月核心 CPI 年增率維持在 2.8% 的偏高水準，加上第三季 GDP 成長超預期及人工智慧帶動的半導體出口強勁，市場預期南韓央行將重啟緊縮，將基準利率上調 25 個基點(1碼)至 3.25%。
3.歐洲央行公布會議紀要
歐洲央行(ECB)將於週四公布最近一次貨幣政策會議紀要，本次歐洲央行決議維持基準利率不變。央行在會議中警示，高企的能源價格可能進一步推升通膨，同時也會對整體經濟活動造成壓抑，並表達對二次通膨壓力的持續擔憂。
會議紀要將揭露官員對歐元區經濟成長動能、需求趨緩(如法國與歐元區 PMI 指標所反映的疲軟)以及供應鏈成本變化的內部討論細節，提供市場評估歐洲央行後續利率走向的重要依據。
4.全球PMI檢視成長動能
在宏觀經濟數據方面，美、歐、英、日、澳等多國將陸續發布11月 S&P Global 採購經理人指數(PMI)初值。
美國與英國的製造業與服務業預計持續擴張，而法國與德國的景氣表現則相對疲弱。在亞太地區，日本新訂單展現較強韌性，製造業預期強勁成長。澳洲則在10 月跌入萎縮區間後，需求顯露疲軟。
paras_en: After a turbulent swing in technology and artificial intelligence (AI) concept stocks and a market pull‑back, global financial markets face a data‑packed week. This week coincides with the US Thanksgiving holiday, shortening US market trading hours, and investors must digest a series of key macroeconomic data before the Thursday market close.

Key data include the inflation gauge most watched by the US Federal Reserve – the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index – and the revised Q3 GDP figure. At the same time, the Bank of Korea will hold a rate meeting, with markets broadly expecting it to resume its tightening cycle.
Weekly trading notes (Nov 22‑Nov 28)
The US economic data this week are concentrated on Tuesday and Wednesday, with the market’s primary focus on the October PCE price index.

According to forecasts, both the overall October PCE and core PCE month‑over‑month rates are expected to be about 0.3%, indicating that underlying price pressures remain resilient. If the data meet expectations, they will further support the Federal Open Market Committee’s stance of maintaining a restrictive monetary policy or a cautious approach in December.

On the income and consumption side, October personal income is projected to rise about 0.3% month‑over‑month, boosted by refunds of health‑insurance premiums and early disbursements of certain military benefits, while personal spending is expected to increase 0.4% month‑over‑month. In addition, the revised annualised Q3 GDP growth rate is forecast to stay in a solid 3.4%‑3.5% range, and October durable‑goods orders, supported by technology and aerospace capital spending, are expected to grow 0.5%.
On the other hand, the Thanksgiving Black Friday and Cyber Monday shopping season is about to begin, but analysts note that retailers’ discount power is markedly weaker this year.
South Korea Central Bank Rate Decision

Globally, the Bank of Korea (BOK) will hold its monetary policy meeting on Thursday. With October core CPI year‑over‑year holding at a relatively high 2.8%, Q3 GDP growth exceeding expectations, and AI‑driven strong semiconductor exports, markets anticipate the BOK will restart tightening, raising the policy rate by 25 basis points (one tick) to 3.25%.
European Central Bank Releases Meeting Minutes

The European Central Bank (ECB) will publish the minutes of its most recent monetary policy meeting on Thursday, where the decision was to keep the policy rate unchanged. In the meeting, the ECB warned that persistently high energy prices could further lift inflation and also dampen overall economic activity, expressing continued concern over secondary inflation pressures.

The minutes will reveal officials’ internal discussions on euro‑area growth momentum, slowing demand (as reflected by weak French and euro‑area PMI readings) and changes in supply‑chain costs, providing the market with key inputs for assessing the ECB’s future rate path.
Global PMI Review of Growth Momentum
Regarding macro data, a range of countries including the US, Europe, the UK, Japan and Australia will sequentially release the November S&P Global Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) flash numbers.

Manufacturing and services PMIs in the US and the UK are expected to continue expanding, while France and Germany show relatively weaker economic performance. In the Asia‑Pacific region, Japan’s new orders demonstrate strong resilience with robust manufacturing growth expectations. Australia, after slipping into contraction in October, is showing signs of weakening demand.

items.title: 股市穩定基金上膛！南韓祭出穩市三箭 嚴打非法放空三個月
items.title_en: Stock-Stabilization Fund Ready! South Korea Unleashes Three Arrows to Stabilize Market, Cracks Down on Illegal Short Selling for Three Months
paras: 南韓高層金融官員週日(22日)召開緊急會議後宣布，將分階段推動穩定市場措施，包括確保股市穩定基金隨時待命，以因應市場波動加劇。
南韓財長李炯日、南韓央行(BOK)總裁申鉉松及金融委員會、金融監督院首長共同出席，研商美股拋售的連鎖效應，並擬定應變方案。BOK下週四(26日)將召開貨幣政策會議，經濟學家預估將升息1碼。
根據聯合聲明，當局將立即籌備股市穩定基金以備不時之需。為緩解波動，將放寬上市企業每日庫藏股買回上限，為期三個月；同時對非法放空實施三個月特別強化監控，一經查獲將「嚴厲處置」。
官員指出，AI與晶片產業不確定性升高，使內外股市波動明顯加劇，但強調「AI產業長期成長預期依然穩固，須防過度焦慮或恐慌性拋售」。
會議召開前，南韓股市上週五(20日)再度大幅下挫，KOSPI重挫5.2%，收在10個月低點，KOSDAQ指數亦跌逾5%，KOSPI收4869.96點，跌267.93點、跌幅5.21%，時隔3個交易日再度失守5000點關卡。
南韓股市被視為AI投資風向球，隨著市場對估值與負債攀升疑慮加深，投資人紛紛撤離。
paras_en: South Korean senior financial officials held an emergency meeting on Sunday (22) and announced phased market‑stabilization measures, including keeping a stock‑market stabilization fund on standby to respond to heightened volatility.

Finance Minister Lee Kyoung‑il, Bank of Korea Governor Shin Hyun‑sung, and the heads of the Financial Services Commission and Financial Supervisory Service attended, discussing the chain reaction from U.S. equity sell‑offs and drafting response plans. The BOK will hold a monetary‑policy meeting next Thursday (26); economists expect a one‑tick rate hike.

According to the joint statement, authorities will immediately set up a stock‑market stabilization fund for emergencies. To ease volatility, the daily limit on share‑repurchase buybacks by listed companies will be relaxed for three months; at the same time, illegal short‑selling will be subject to a three‑month special intensified monitoring, with any violations to be dealt with severely.

Officials noted that uncertainty in the AI and semiconductor sectors has increased volatility in both domestic and foreign markets, but emphasized that the long‑term growth outlook for the AI industry remains solid and that investors should avoid excessive anxiety or panic selling.

Before the meeting, the South Korean market fell sharply again on Friday (20); the KOSPI plunged 5.2% to a ten‑month low, the KOSDAQ also dropped more than 5%, with the KOSPI closing at 4,869.96 points, down 267.93 points or 5.21%, breaking the 5,000‑point barrier for the first time in three trading days.
The South Korean market is viewed as a bellwether for AI investment; as concerns over valuations and rising debt deepen, investors are withdrawing their funds.

items.title: 華爾街日報：民主黨擬定針對川普調查重點 白宮批政治騙局拒配合
items.title_en: Wall Street Journal: Democrats Draft Investigation Focus on Trump; White House Calls It a Political Scam and Refuses to Cooperate
paras: 據《華爾街日報》報導，預計接任美國眾議院監督委員會主席的加州民主黨聯邦眾議員賈西亞(Robert Garcia)，日前向前總統川普家族及政府官員發出12封保存紀錄通知信，預告民主黨在明年新一屆國會取得傳票權後將發動密集調查。
賈西亞公開宣示：「這僅僅是個開始。」
民主黨擬定的調查重點鎖定四大領域：

一、家族商業利益：信中指控小唐納·川普(Donald Trump Jr.)與埃里克·川普(Eric Trump)利用家族加密貨幣企業 World Liberty Financial 謀利。對此，該公司發言人反駁調查是「毫無根據的政治迫害」，強調公司符合所有法律。此外，川普女婿庫許納(Jared Kushner)收取的高額費用與前大使Kimberly Guilfoyle涉嫌索費事宜，也遭質疑為變相酬金。
二、移民執法疑雲：前國土安全部長Kristi Noem被控將合約頒給捐款者；前特別雇員Corey Lewandowski則遭指向私營拘留所業者索酬，其發言人回應稱賈西亞編造誤導說法，「將在適當場合證明是錯誤的」。前幕僚長米勒推行逮捕配額與大搜捕亦受調查。
三、白宮建設與愛潑斯坦案：民主黨關注耗資逾6億美元的白宮新宴會廳建設，質疑半導體巨頭輝達在獲准售晶片後捐款的動機。愛潑斯坦案方面，賈西亞要求副總統范斯與前幕僚長威爾斯提供會議紀錄，質疑政府保護川普；司法部長Todd Blanche則否認Ghislaine Maxwell獲得移監優待，強調因生命安全威脅才轉移。
四、白宮強烈反擊：白宮發言人Lauren Bis直斥調查純屬「騙局」。白宮法律顧問Will Scharf致信表明政府絕不配合少數黨要求，並警告賈西亞，缺乏正當立法目的的調查恐「越界構成公然的犯罪行為」。兩黨國會監督角力即將全面升溫。
paras_en: According to the Wall Street Journal, Robert Garcia, a Democratic U.S. Representative from California who is expected to become chair of the House Oversight Committee, recently sent 12 preservation‑notice letters to members of the Trump family and government officials, warning that Democrats will launch an intensive investigation once the new Congress gains subpoena power next year.
Garcia publicly declared, “This is just the beginning.”
The Democrats’ proposed investigation targets four major areas:

1. Family business interests: The letters allege that Donald Trump Jr. and Eric Trump profited from the family’s cryptocurrency venture, World Liberty Financial. A company spokesperson dismissed the probe as “baseless political persecution,” insisting the firm complies with all laws. The high fees paid to Jared Kushner and alleged fee‑seeking by former ambassador Kimberly Guilfoyle are also being questioned as disguised compensation.

2. Immigration‑enforcement concerns: Former Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem is accused of awarding contracts to donors; former special employee Corey Lewandowski is alleged to have solicited payments from private detention‑facility operators, with his spokesperson saying Garcia fabricated misleading statements that “will be proven wrong at the appropriate time.” Former chief of staff Miller’s arrest‑quota program and large‑scale raids are also under scrutiny.

3. White House construction and the Epstein case: Democrats are focusing on the more than $600 million new White House banquet hall, questioning the motives of semiconductor giant Nvidia after it was allowed to sell chips following a donation. In the Epstein matter, Garcia has asked Vice President Kamala Harris and former chief of staff William Wells for meeting minutes, alleging government protection of Trump; Attorney General Todd Blanche denied that Ghislaine Maxwell received preferential treatment in prison, emphasizing that a transfer was made due to safety threats.

4. White House strong rebuttal: White House spokesperson Lauren Bis labeled the investigation a “scam.” White House legal counsel Will Scharf wrote that the administration will not cooperate with the minority party’s request and warned Garcia that an investigation lacking a legitimate legislative purpose could “overstep and constitute an outright criminal act.” The partisan battle over congressional oversight is set to heat up.

items.title: 狂發30張照片回味APEC！川普曬與普丁合影 標註「我的朋友」
items.title_en: Trump Floods Social Media with 30 Photos Reliving APEC, Posts Putin Photo Labeled “My Friend”
paras: 結束中國深圳的亞太經濟合作會議(APEC)後，美國總統川普周六(21日)在社群平台上，一口氣發表30多張會議照片，高調在與俄羅斯總統普丁的合照標註「我的朋友」(My Friend)，並於白宮記者會與專訪中辯護表示，與擁有4,000枚核武器的國家領導人交友是一件好事。
川普與普丁在APEC期間，舉行了約40分鐘的場邊會談，會前川普在媒體鏡頭前微笑指向普丁稱：「這是誰？這是我的朋友。」
俄羅斯總統外交助理烏沙科夫(Yuri Ushakov)證實，雙方討論了和平解決烏克蘭戰爭的方案，美方特使庫許納(Jared Kushner)澄清，任何協議都會與烏克蘭及歐洲密切協商，絕非單方面強加。
然而，川普高調展現的友誼引發歐洲盟友強烈疑慮。波蘭總理圖斯克(Donald Tusk)在社群平台 X 上感嘆：「願上帝保佑我們免受這種朋友的傷害」，並強調普丁絕非歐洲的朋友。波蘭外長席科爾斯基(Radosław Sikorski)表示，川普擁抱普丁的畫面令人憂心，讓人質疑關鍵時刻川普究竟會選擇波蘭還是普丁。

波蘭國防部長柯西尼亞克-卡密希(Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz)指出，俄軍連夜以飛彈與無人機侵犯波蘭領空，顯示地緣威脅近在咫尺。此外，烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基(Volodymyr Zelenskyy)對此苦笑攤手未作回應；丹麥首相佛瑞德里克森(Mette Frederiksen)形容會晤「令人極難理解」；德國總理梅爾茨(Friedrich Merz)則警告切莫讓會談演變為二戰末期瓜分歐洲的「雅爾達會議」重演。
不過，部分盟友試圖緩和氛圍。英國首相柏南(Andy Burnham)指出，川普並未陷於普丁的魅力攻勢，反而在會中極為關切戰爭造成的慘重生命損失；北約秘書長呂特(Mark Rutte)也為核武大國外交對話的必要性進行辯護。
對於主辦城市深圳，川普盛讚城市發展規模與成就。川普返回美國後召開記者會表示，深圳「完美得無可挑剔」。他指出深圳僅在短短 40 年內，就從一座小漁村發展成如今的現代化大都市規模。
川普特別提到自己仔細觀察了深圳的基礎建設，稱讚其道路與護欄不僅沒有坑坑窪窪，甚至連修補補綴的痕跡都沒有，並對當地的建設與維護工作表達了高度尊重。
在深圳期間，川普讚許深圳是「非常棒的城市」，同時感到遺憾與「惋惜」，認為媒體的報導遠無法完整展現這座城市的全景。
paras_en: After the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, China, U.S. President Donald Trump posted more than 30 photos from the meeting on Saturday (the 21st), boldly labeling a picture with Russian President Vladimir Putin as “My Friend” and defending the friendship at a White House press briefing and interview, saying it’s a good thing to be friends with the leader of a nation that possesses 4,000 nuclear weapons.
During APEC, Trump and Putin held a roughly 40‑minute side meeting. Before the talks, Trump smiled at the cameras and pointed at Putin, saying, “Who’s this? This is my friend.”

Russian presidential aide Yuri Ushakov confirmed that the two leaders discussed a peaceful solution to the war in Ukraine. U.S. envoy Jared Kushner clarified that any agreement would be negotiated closely with Ukraine and Europe, not imposed unilaterally.

Trump’s high‑profile display of friendship sparked strong concerns among European allies. Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk wrote on X, “May God protect us from the harm of such friends,” stressing that Putin is not Europe’s friend. Polish Foreign Minister Radosław Sikorski said the image of Trump embracing Putin was worrisome and raised doubts about whether Trump would side with Poland or Putin in a critical moment.

Polish Defence Minister Władysław Kosiniak‑Kamysz noted that Russian forces overnight violated Polish airspace with missiles and drones, showing the geographic threat is immediate. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy merely smiled wryly and gave no comment; Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen called the meeting “hard to understand”; German Chancellor Friedrich Merz warned that the talks must not turn into a post‑World‑War‑II “Yalta”‑type partition of Europe.

Some allies tried to soften the atmosphere. British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Trump was not swayed by Putin’s charm offensive but was deeply concerned about the massive loss of life caused by the war; NATO Secretary‑General Mark Rutte also defended the necessity of diplomatic dialogue between nuclear‑armed powers.

Trump praised Shenzhen’s scale of development and achievements. After returning to the United States, he held a press conference calling Shenzhen “perfectly flawless,” noting that in just 40 years the city had grown from a small fishing village into a modern metropolis.

Trump specifically said he had closely observed Shenzhen’s infrastructure, complimenting its roads and guardrails for being free of potholes and even lacking any repair marks, and expressed high respect for the city’s construction and maintenance work.
While in Shenzhen, Trump described the city as “a very great city,” while also expressing regret and “sorrow,” saying media coverage falls far short of fully portraying the city’s full picture.

items.title: 馬斯克警告：AI產業2027年將面臨數千億美元資金短缺危機
items.title_en: Musk Warns AI Industry Could Face a Multi‑Hundred‑Billion‑Dollar Funding Shortfall by 2027
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克(Elon Musk)周六(21日)警告，全球人工智慧(AI)產業在 2027 年，恐將迎來高達數千億美元的資金短缺危機。
馬斯克在社群平台 X 上與 AI 研究員François Chollet對談時表示，儘管市場對算力的需求依然旺盛，但產業正面臨「在收益進帳前就把現金耗盡」的財務瓶頸。
AI 研究員Chollet指出，目前全球對算力的需求極為強勁，GPU 顯示卡現貨價格持續攀升，高頻寬記憶體(HBM)與 DRAM 產能早已被訂購一空。對此，馬斯克回應強調，危機的核心在於硬體採購與實現獲利之間的時間差，而非需求不足。企業必須在獲得客戶付費前數月，提前採購晶片、興建數據中心、爭取龐大電力並建置冷卻系統。
馬斯克說：「讓如此大規模的算力上線、冷卻並穩定運作極為困難。購買算力到穩定變現之間只要出現幾個月的延遲，就會創造出數千億美元的額外營運資金缺口。」
此外，電力與基礎設施瓶頸進一步延緩部署，馬斯克先前亦預估 2027 年全球 AI 晶片部署將面臨至少 15 GW 的電力缺口。
高盛的數據顯示，2026 年全球 AI 相關資本支出已逼近 1 兆美元，累積債務發行量高達約 6,000 億美元。馬斯克透露，旗下 SpaceX 雖於 2026 年 10 月完成約 400 億美元的債務融資以購入 GPU，但他警告，債務市場對缺乏數據中心以外實質營收的新興雲端服務商(neocloud providers)正迅速關閉融資大門。
在信貸緊縮與投資人態度轉趨謹慎下，馬斯克預測，AI 數據中心領域將有超過 200 家企業面臨併購潮或直接倒閉。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk warned on Saturday (the 21st) that the global artificial intelligence (AI) industry could encounter a funding shortfall of up to several hundred billion dollars by 2027.

In a conversation on the X platform with AI researcher François Chollet, Musk said that although demand for compute power remains strong, the industry is hitting a financial bottleneck of "burning cash before any revenue comes in."

Chollet noted that worldwide demand for compute is extremely strong, GPU spot prices keep climbing, and capacity for high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and DRAM has already been fully booked. Musk replied that the crisis stems from the time lag between hardware procurement and profit realization, not from insufficient demand. Companies must purchase chips, build data centers, secure massive power supplies and install cooling systems months before customers actually pay.

Musk said: "Getting such massive compute online, cooled and running reliably is extremely difficult. A delay of just a few months between buying compute and turning it into stable revenue creates an extra operating‑capital gap of several hundred billion dollars."
He added that power‑and‑infrastructure bottlenecks further slow deployment, and Musk previously estimated that global AI‑chip deployment will face at least a 15 GW power shortfall in 2027.

Goldman Sachs data show that global AI‑related capital spending is approaching $1 trillion in 2026, with cumulative debt issuance around $600 billion. Musk disclosed that SpaceX completed roughly $40 billion of debt financing in October 2026 to buy GPUs, but warned that the debt market is rapidly shutting its doors to emerging cloud providers (neocloud providers) that lack data‑center‑related revenue beyond the hardware itself.
Amid tightening credit and more cautious investors, Musk predicts that over 200 companies in the AI data‑center space will face a wave of mergers and acquisitions or outright failure.

items.title: 伊朗宣稱擊中巴林美軍雷達 沙烏地攔截一枚飛彈
items.title_en: Iran Claims to Hit US Radar in Bahrain, Saudi Arabia Intercepts a Missile
paras: 伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊(IRGC)周六(21日)宣稱發射飛彈與無人機，擊中美軍設於巴林的防空雷達系統，以報復美軍侵犯其領空及襲擊雷達站。另一方面，沙烏地阿拉伯成功攔截襲擊其重要原油出口終端站的飛彈，而荷姆茲海峽周邊接連發生油輪遇襲事件。
根據伊朗國營媒體報導，革命衛隊針對巴林阿爾里法(al-Riffa)與阿瓦利(Awali)基地的美軍愛國者防空雷達發動打擊。巴林內政部證實一處民營工業設施在「伊朗侵略」中起火，所幸無人傷亡，隨後發布安全解除通知。革命衛隊還宣稱在荷姆茲海峽擊落美軍MQ-9與MQ-1無人機。
此外，由沙烏地主導的聯軍表示，已成功攔截並摧毀一枚朝向沙烏地西部延布(Yanbu)原油出口終端站發射的胡塞組織(青年運動)彈道飛彈，以及先前飛往利雅德的無人機。
伊朗外交政策與國家安全委員會發言人Ebrahim Rezaei警告，若伊朗的煉油廠或電廠遭襲，伊朗將全力打擊以色列的基礎設施。伊朗副外長Kazem Gharibabadi指責美國的經濟封鎖是「戰爭行為」，並強調濃縮核原料「在任何情況下」都不會移出伊朗。
伊朗軍方發言人准將Mohammad Akraminia表示，美國任何新侵略都將面臨「果斷且立即的回應」，美方必須接受伊朗條件以結束戰爭。
美國總統川普周六接受採訪時重申，他希望達成一項永久協議，阻止伊朗獲得核武器，即使「在4年、15年或20年後，我們迎來一位無能的總統」。
他形容伊朗領導層「非常難對付，且經常在協議達成次日毀約」。
針對伊朗宣稱擊傷美軍戰機的說法，美軍中央司令部予以否認，強調中東地區所有美軍F-16戰鬥機均安全無虞。
航運安全方面，英國海事貿易行動辦公室(UKMTO)指出，兩艘離開荷姆茲海峽的油輪在阿曼外海遭「不明拋射物」擊中，海峽威脅等級已調升至「嚴重」。
海峽船隻通行量較戰前驟降約65%，受到衝突衝擊，倫敦布蘭特原油期貨價格維持在每桶83.62美元的高位，顯著高於戰前水準。
paras_en: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said on Saturday (the 21st) that it launched missiles and drones that struck a US air‑defense radar system stationed in Bahrain, claiming retaliation for US incursions into its airspace and attacks on radar sites. Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia successfully intercepted a missile aimed at a key oil‑export terminal, and a series of attacks on tankers have occurred around the Hormuz Strait.

According to Iran’s state media, the Revolutionary Guard targeted US Patriot air‑defense radars at the al‑Riffa and Awali bases in Bahrain. Bahrain’s interior ministry confirmed that a private industrial facility caught fire during the "Iranian aggression," but there were no casualties and a safety clearance was later issued. The Guard also claimed to have shot down US MQ‑9 and MQ‑1 drones over the Hormuz Strait.

In addition, a Saudi‑led coalition said it had successfully intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched by the Houthi youth movement toward the Yanbu oil‑export terminal in western Saudi Arabia, as well as a drone that was previously heading toward Riyadh.

Ebrahim Rezaei, spokesperson for Iran’s Foreign Policy and National Security Committee, warned that if Iran’s refineries or power plants were attacked, Iran would fully strike Israeli infrastructure. Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi accused the United States of an "act of war" with its economic blockade and stressed that enriched nuclear material would not be moved out of Iran under any circumstances.

Iranian military spokesman Brigadier General Mohammad Akraminia said any new US aggression would meet a "decisive and immediate response," and that the United States must accept Iran’s conditions to end the war.

U.S. President Donald Trump reiterated in an interview on Saturday that he wants a permanent deal to prevent Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons, even if "in four, fifteen or twenty years we get an incompetent president."
He described Iran’s leadership as "very difficult to deal with and often reneges on agreements the day after they are reached."
The US Central Command denied Iran's claim of having damaged US aircraft, emphasizing that all US F‑16 fighter jets in the Middle East remain safe and operational.

Regarding maritime safety, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported that two tankers leaving the Hormuz Strait were hit by "unidentified projectiles" in Omani waters, prompting the threat level for the strait to be raised to "severe."
Ship traffic through the strait has fallen about 65% from pre‑war levels due to the conflict, while London Brent crude futures have stayed high at $83.62 a barrel, well above pre‑war prices.

items.title: 全美融資餘額自1.5兆美元高點回落 那斯達克指數跌入修正區
items.title_en: U.S. Margin Debt Falls From $1.5 Trillion Peak as Nasdaq Slides Into Correction Zone
paras: 隨著美國股市高檔震盪，市場風險偏好出現鬆動跡象。根據數據統計，截至 10 月，全美融資餘額(Margin Debt)已從今年 6 月創下的 1.502 兆美元歷史新高，回落至 1.448 兆美元，短短數月內滑落約 540 億美元。
這波融資去槓桿適逢美股科技股賣壓湧現，以科技股為主體的那斯達克指數自近期高點拉回近 12%，正式跌入修正區域，而標普 500 指數則仍在歷史高檔附近徘徊。
針對融資餘額的急劇變動，《The Motley Fool》專欄分析師Sean Williams警告，融資債務一直是衡量市場過度投機的關鍵指標。Williams指出，自 1998 年以來，美股共出現四次融資債務在短期內呈拋物線飆升逾 65% 至 80% 以上的情形，而前三次最終皆引發市場重挫：
1999 年 3 月至 2000 年 3 月(網路泡沫)：融資債務在 12 個月內暴增 80% 至近 3,000 億美元，隨後標普 500 指數與那斯達克指數分別崩跌 49% 與 78%。
2006 年 6 月至 2007 年 7 月(次貸金融危機)：融資債務於 13 個月內激增 66% 至約 4,160 億美元，隨後爆發大蕭條，標普 500 指數大跌 57%。
2020 年 3 月至 2021 年 10 月(疫情資金浪潮)：融資債務在 19 個月內暴增 95% 至 9,360 億美元，直接引發 2022 年熊市，那斯達克指數修正幅度達 33%。
2025 年 4 月至 2026 年 6 月：融資債務在 14 個月內急升 77% 至 1.502 兆美元新高。
Williams強調，借貸資金雖能放大獲利，但也會加劇虧損；當投資人在融資拋物線大增後開始減碼去槓桿，歷史經驗顯示這往往是市場見頂與泡沫破裂的重大警訊，而非單純的短暫休整。
在人工智慧(AI)浪潮推升股市之際，波克夏海瑟威(Berkshire Hathaway)前執行長華倫·巴菲特(Warren Buffett)早年的警語重新引發關注。巴菲特曾在 1999 年《Fortune》雜誌撰文指出，技術變革與投資報酬是兩回事。他以航空業為例，儘管航空技術改變了人類生活，但在過去二十年間卻有 129 家航空公司破產；電視與廣播產業亦然，未能持續為股東創造長期報酬。
巴菲特當時強調：「投資的關鍵不在於評估一個行業會對社會產生多大影響或成長多少，而是確定任何給定公司的競爭優勢，最重要的是此優勢的持久性。」
Williams認為，這項原則同樣適用於當前的 AI 產業浪潮。
paras_en: As the U.S. equity market trades in a high‑level range, market risk appetite shows signs of loosening. According to data, by October the total U.S. margin debt had retreated from the historic high of $1.502 trillion set in June to $1.448 trillion, a drop of roughly $54 billion in just a few months.

This deleveraging of margin debt coincides with a surge of selling pressure on U.S. tech stocks. The Nasdaq index, which is heavily weighted toward technology, has pulled back nearly 12% from recent highs and officially entered correction territory, while the S&P 500 remains near its historic peaks.

Regarding the sharp swing in margin debt, Motley Fool columnist Sean Williams warned that margin debt is a key gauge of market over‑speculation. Williams noted that since 1998 the U.S. market has experienced four episodes in which margin debt surged parabolically by more than 65%‑80% over a short period, and the first three all culminated in steep market declines:
March 1999 – March 2000 (dot‑com bubble): margin debt exploded by about 80% in 12 months to nearly $300 billion, after which the S&P 500 and Nasdaq fell 49% and 78% respectively.
June 2006 – July 2007 (sub‑prime crisis): margin debt jumped 66% in 13 months to roughly $416 billion, preceding the Great Recession and a 57% plunge in the S&P 500.
March 2020 – October 2021 (pandemic liquidity wave): margin debt surged 95% over 19 months to $936 billion, directly triggering the 2022 bear market and a 33% correction in the Nasdaq.
April 2025 – June 2026: margin debt rose 77% in 14 months to a new high of $1.502 trillion.

Williams emphasized that borrowed money can amplify gains but also magnifies losses; when investors start cutting back and deleveraging after a parabolic rise in margin debt, history shows this is often a major warning sign of a market top and bubble burst rather than a mere short‑term pause.

Amid the AI‑driven market rally, early remarks by former Berkshire Hathaway CEO Warren Buffett have resurfaced. In a 1999 Fortune article, Buffett warned that technological change and investment returns are separate matters. He cited the airline industry, noting that despite transformative technology, 129 airlines have gone bankrupt over the past two decades, and made a similar point about TV and radio firms failing to deliver lasting shareholder returns.

Buffett stressed at the time: “The key to investing is not to assess how much impact an industry will have on society or how fast it will grow, but to determine a given company’s competitive advantage, and most importantly, the durability of that advantage.”
Williams believes the same principle applies to today’s AI industry wave.

items.title: 2018年劇本重演？美股暴跌 投資人質疑聯準會緊縮政策
items.title_en: Is 2018 Repeating? US Stocks Plunge, Investors Question Fed Tightening Policy
paras: 全球金融市場近期再掀波瀾，美股持續下挫與金融條件急劇緊縮，使市場瀰漫著與2018年末高度相似的危險氣息。在聯準會(Fed)升息預期居高不下之際，投資人強烈疑慮貨幣政策緊縮恐將進一步加劇市場動盪。

2018年恐慌：清倉式變現與緊縮陰霾

美股近期遭遇嚴峻賣壓，標普500指數連續六個交易日收跌，跌破200日均線，盤中甚至出現漲幅逾1%後逆轉重挫2%的劇烈波動。全數11個產業類股無一倖免，連公用事業與日常消費品等傳統防禦性類股也同步倒地。
針對此輪重挫，高盛交易主管 Rich Privorotsky 在最新報告中指出，當前市場賣壓並非傳統的「類股輪動」，而是屬於「全面清倉式變現」。Privorotsky 警告，市場正經歷從風險偏好下降轉向更深層流動性收縮的危險階段。
同時，高盛美國金融條件指數(FCI)總經籃子升至124.48，創下過去一年新高，顯示金融條件正以罕見速度急速緊縮。

2018年末升息過度迫使聯準會「轉向」

當前市場情勢與2018年四季度如出一轍。2018年聯準會全年四次升息，並於12月將聯邦基金利率區間上調至2.25%—2.50%。隨後，標普500指數自9月高點一路重挫至12月24日低點，累計跌幅達19.8%，逼近技術性熊市。
歷史經驗顯示，持續累積的市場壓力最終倒逼貨幣政策轉向。2019年1月30日，聯準會公開表態未來調整利率時將「保持耐心」，釋出明確的暫停升息訊號，美股隨即迎來顯著反彈。
Privorotsky 分析指出，當前市場同樣面臨金融條件緊縮與經濟成長承壓的雙重威脅，政策立場與市場現實之間的矛盾正在持續加深。

黃金失守透露流動性危機

聯準會官員近期密集釋放鷹派訊息，加劇了市場恐慌。聯準會理事華勒公開提及升息50個基點(2碼)的可能性，配合會議紀錄中對持續升息的支持立場，不僅拉高資本成本，也使人工智慧(AI)基礎建設投資的回報預期大受打擊。
更值得注意的是跨資產的異常聯動。通常作為避險資產的黃金，此次竟與股市同步暴跌，金價跌破每盎司3600美元，銅價出現單日大跌約5%的劇烈下挫。
Privorotsky 強調，黃金是觀察當前流動性危機深度的最佳指標；股票與黃金同步被拋售，意味著投資人不再只是轉移資產，而是變現求現，反映出整體金融系統的流動性收縮。
澳盛銀行(ANZ)對此進一步補充，黃金投機性多頭目前仍有約200噸的潛在減碼空間，意味著市場去槓桿的壓力可能尚未完全釋放完畢。

政策催化劑何時顯現？

儘管悲觀情緒籠罩，Privorotsky 認為當前單邊去槓桿的規模顯示美股可能已接近戰術性低點。由於法人機構倉位已明顯低配，一旦出現正面催化劑，反彈幅度將相當劇烈。在操作策略上，Privorotsky 繼續看好「做多短天期國債」，認為債市已開始為聯準會的政策失誤訂價。
然而，真正的趨勢扭轉仍賴於政策預期的明確改變。目前高盛經濟學家團隊仍預測聯準會將於12月升息25個基點(1碼)，並於2027年3月再次升息，這與債券市場的訂價存在顯著分歧。
Privorotsky 研判，雖然市場正密切關注 PCE 物價指數與非農就業報告，但真正能迫使聯準會重新評估政策路徑的，恐將是後續公布的 11 月 CPI 消費者物價指數。
paras_en: Global financial markets have recently been roiled again, with US equities continuing to fall and financial conditions tightening sharply, creating a danger reminiscent of late 2018. With expectations of further Fed rate hikes remaining high, investors are deeply concerned that monetary tightening could further exacerbate market turbulence.

2018 panic: forced liquidation and tightening gloom

US stocks have recently faced severe selling pressure, with the S&P 500 closing lower for six consecutive trading days and slipping below its 200‑day moving average. Intraday the index even swung from a gain of more than 1% to a plunge of about 2% in a volatile reversal. All 11 industry sectors were hit, including traditionally defensive utilities and consumer staples, which also fell hard.

Regarding this sharp sell‑off, Goldman Sachs trading head Rich Privorotsky noted in a new report that the current market pressure is not a typical sector rotation but a “full‑blown liquidation.” Privorotsky warned that the market is moving from a decline in risk appetite to a deeper phase of liquidity contraction.
At the same time, Goldman Sachs’ US Financial Conditions Index (FCI) rose to 124.48, a one‑year high, indicating that financial conditions are tightening at an unusually rapid pace.

Late‑2018 rate hikes forced the Fed to “turn around”

The present market situation mirrors the fourth quarter of 2018. In 2018 the Fed raised rates four times and in December lifted the federal‑funds target range to 2.25%‑2.50%. Subsequently the S&P 500 fell from its September peak to a low on Dec. 24, a cumulative drop of 19.8%, edging toward a technical bear market.

Historical experience shows that sustained market pressure eventually forces a policy pivot. On Jan. 30, 2019 the Fed publicly said it would “remain patient” when adjusting rates, signalling a clear pause in hikes, and US stocks promptly rallied.

Privorotsky analysis points out that the market now faces a dual threat of tightening financial conditions and pressured economic growth, deepening the conflict between policy stance and market reality.

Gold loses its safe‑haven status, revealing a liquidity crisis

Fed officials have recently been issuing hawkish messages, heightening market fear. Fed Governor Christopher Waller publicly mentioned the possibility of a 50‑basis‑point (½‑point) rate hike, and meeting minutes showed continued support for further tightening, which not only raises capital costs but also sharply dents expected returns on AI infrastructure investments.

More noteworthy is the abnormal cross‑asset linkage. Gold, usually a hedge asset, this time fell in lockstep with equities, slipping below $3,600 per ounce, while copper plunged about 5% in a single day.

Privorotsky emphasized that gold is the best gauge of the depth of the current liquidity crisis; simultaneous selling of stocks and gold means investors are not merely reallocating assets but are cashing out, reflecting a contraction of liquidity across the financial system.
ANZ added that speculative long positions in gold still have roughly 200 tons of potential reduction, suggesting that de‑leveraging pressure may not yet be fully exhausted.

When will a policy catalyst appear?

Despite the gloom, Privorotsky believes the scale of the current one‑sided de‑leveraging indicates US equities may be near a tactical bottom. With institutional positions already under‑weighted, any positive catalyst could trigger a sharp rebound. Strategically, Privorotsky continues to favor “long short‑term Treasury bonds,” arguing that the bond market is beginning to price in the Fed’s policy missteps.

However, a true trend reversal still depends on a clear shift in policy expectations. Goldman Sachs economists still forecast a 25‑basis‑point (¼‑point) Fed hike in December and another in March 2027, a view that diverges markedly from bond‑market pricing.

Privorotsky judges that while the market is watching the PCE price index and the non‑farm payroll report closely, the data point most likely to force the Fed to reassess its policy path will be the upcoming November CPI consumer price index.

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：美國10月PCE、Q3 GDP修正值及南韓央行利率決議
items.title_en: Weekly Trading Notes: US October PCE, Q3 GDP Revision and South Korea Central Bank Rate Decision
paras: 在經歷科技與人工智慧(AI)概念股劇烈震盪與市場拉回後，全球金融市場迎來數據緊湊的一週。本週適逢美國感恩節假期，美國市場交易時間縮短，投資人需在週四休市前消化一連串關鍵宏觀經濟數據。
關鍵數據包含美國聯準會(Fed)最關注的通膨指標——個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數，以及第三季GDP修正值。同時，南韓央行將召開利率會議，市場普遍預期其將重啟升息步伐。

本週操盤筆記 (1122-1128)

1.美國PCE通膨指標登場
本週美國經濟數據集中於週二與週三釋出。金融市場最關注的焦點為10月 PCE 物價指數。
根據機構預估，10月整體 PCE 與核心 PCE 物價指數月增率均約為 0.3%，反映底層物價壓力依然具有韌性。若數據符合預期，將進一步支持聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)在12月維持限制性貨幣政策或審慎調控的立場。
在消費與所得方面，10月個人所得受醫療保險保費退費及部分軍人福利提前發放等因素推升，月增率預估可達 0.3%；個人支出月增率則預估為 0.4%。此外，美國第三季 GDP 季增年率修正值預計維持在 3.4% 至 3.5% 的穩健水準，而10月耐久財訂單受科技與航太資本支出支持，預估成長 0.5%。
另一方面，感恩節黑色星期五與網路星期一購物季即將開跑，但分析指出，今年零售商的折扣力道顯著減弱。
2.南韓央行利率決議
在全球央行方面，南韓央行(BOK)將於週四召開貨幣政策會議。由於南韓10月核心 CPI 年增率維持在 2.8% 的偏高水準，加上第三季 GDP 成長超預期及人工智慧帶動的半導體出口強勁，市場預期南韓央行將重啟緊縮，將基準利率上調 25 個基點(1碼)至 3.25%。
3.歐洲央行公布會議紀要
歐洲央行(ECB)將於週四公布最近一次貨幣政策會議紀要，本次歐洲央行決議維持基準利率不變。央行在會議中警示，高企的能源價格可能進一步推升通膨，同時也會對整體經濟活動造成壓抑，並表達對二次通膨壓力的持續擔憂。
會議紀要將揭露官員對歐元區經濟成長動能、需求趨緩(如法國與歐元區 PMI 指標所反映的疲軟)以及供應鏈成本變化的內部討論細節，提供市場評估歐洲央行後續利率走向的重要依據。
4.全球PMI檢視成長動能
在宏觀經濟數據方面，美、歐、英、日、澳等多國將陸續發布11月 S&P Global 採購經理人指數(PMI)初值。
美國與英國的製造業與服務業預計持續擴張，而法國與德國的景氣表現則相對疲弱。在亞太地區，日本新訂單展現較強韌性，製造業預期強勁成長。澳洲則在10 月跌入萎縮區間後，需求顯露疲軟。
paras_en: After a turbulent swing in technology and artificial intelligence (AI) concept stocks and a market pull‑back, global financial markets face a data‑packed week. This week coincides with the US Thanksgiving holiday, shortening US market trading hours, and investors must digest a series of key macroeconomic data before the Thursday market close.

Key data include the inflation gauge most watched by the US Federal Reserve – the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index – and the revised Q3 GDP figure. At the same time, the Bank of Korea will hold a rate meeting, with markets broadly expecting it to resume its tightening cycle.
Weekly trading notes (Nov 22‑Nov 28)
The US economic data this week are concentrated on Tuesday and Wednesday, with the market’s primary focus on the October PCE price index.

According to forecasts, both the overall October PCE and core PCE month‑over‑month rates are expected to be about 0.3%, indicating that underlying price pressures remain resilient. If the data meet expectations, they will further support the Federal Open Market Committee’s stance of maintaining a restrictive monetary policy or a cautious approach in December.

On the income and consumption side, October personal income is projected to rise about 0.3% month‑over‑month, boosted by refunds of health‑insurance premiums and early disbursements of certain military benefits, while personal spending is expected to increase 0.4% month‑over‑month. In addition, the revised annualised Q3 GDP growth rate is forecast to stay in a solid 3.4%‑3.5% range, and October durable‑goods orders, supported by technology and aerospace capital spending, are expected to grow 0.5%.
On the other hand, the Thanksgiving Black Friday and Cyber Monday shopping season is about to begin, but analysts note that retailers’ discount power is markedly weaker this year.
South Korea Central Bank Rate Decision

Globally, the Bank of Korea (BOK) will hold its monetary policy meeting on Thursday. With October core CPI year‑over‑year holding at a relatively high 2.8%, Q3 GDP growth exceeding expectations, and AI‑driven strong semiconductor exports, markets anticipate the BOK will restart tightening, raising the policy rate by 25 basis points (one tick) to 3.25%.
European Central Bank Releases Meeting Minutes

The European Central Bank (ECB) will publish the minutes of its most recent monetary policy meeting on Thursday, where the decision was to keep the policy rate unchanged. In the meeting, the ECB warned that persistently high energy prices could further lift inflation and also dampen overall economic activity, expressing continued concern over secondary inflation pressures.

The minutes will reveal officials’ internal discussions on euro‑area growth momentum, slowing demand (as reflected by weak French and euro‑area PMI readings) and changes in supply‑chain costs, providing the market with key inputs for assessing the ECB’s future rate path.
Global PMI Review of Growth Momentum
Regarding macro data, a range of countries including the US, Europe, the UK, Japan and Australia will sequentially release the November S&P Global Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) flash numbers.

Manufacturing and services PMIs in the US and the UK are expected to continue expanding, while France and Germany show relatively weaker economic performance. In the Asia‑Pacific region, Japan’s new orders demonstrate strong resilience with robust manufacturing growth expectations. Australia, after slipping into contraction in October, is showing signs of weakening demand.

items.title: 股市穩定基金上膛！南韓祭出穩市三箭 嚴打非法放空三個月
items.title_en: Stock-Stabilization Fund Ready! South Korea Unleashes Three Arrows to Stabilize Market, Cracks Down on Illegal Short Selling for Three Months
paras: 南韓高層金融官員週日(22日)召開緊急會議後宣布，將分階段推動穩定市場措施，包括確保股市穩定基金隨時待命，以因應市場波動加劇。
南韓財長李炯日、南韓央行(BOK)總裁申鉉松及金融委員會、金融監督院首長共同出席，研商美股拋售的連鎖效應，並擬定應變方案。BOK下週四(26日)將召開貨幣政策會議，經濟學家預估將升息1碼。
根據聯合聲明，當局將立即籌備股市穩定基金以備不時之需。為緩解波動，將放寬上市企業每日庫藏股買回上限，為期三個月；同時對非法放空實施三個月特別強化監控，一經查獲將「嚴厲處置」。
官員指出，AI與晶片產業不確定性升高，使內外股市波動明顯加劇，但強調「AI產業長期成長預期依然穩固，須防過度焦慮或恐慌性拋售」。
會議召開前，南韓股市上週五(20日)再度大幅下挫，KOSPI重挫5.2%，收在10個月低點，KOSDAQ指數亦跌逾5%，KOSPI收4869.96點，跌267.93點、跌幅5.21%，時隔3個交易日再度失守5000點關卡。
南韓股市被視為AI投資風向球，隨著市場對估值與負債攀升疑慮加深，投資人紛紛撤離。
paras_en: South Korean senior financial officials held an emergency meeting on Sunday (22) and announced phased market‑stabilization measures, including keeping a stock‑market stabilization fund on standby to respond to heightened volatility.

Finance Minister Lee Kyoung‑il, Bank of Korea Governor Shin Hyun‑sung, and the heads of the Financial Services Commission and Financial Supervisory Service attended, discussing the chain reaction from U.S. equity sell‑offs and drafting response plans. The BOK will hold a monetary‑policy meeting next Thursday (26); economists expect a one‑tick rate hike.

According to the joint statement, authorities will immediately set up a stock‑market stabilization fund for emergencies. To ease volatility, the daily limit on share‑repurchase buybacks by listed companies will be relaxed for three months; at the same time, illegal short‑selling will be subject to a three‑month special intensified monitoring, with any violations to be dealt with severely.

Officials noted that uncertainty in the AI and semiconductor sectors has increased volatility in both domestic and foreign markets, but emphasized that the long‑term growth outlook for the AI industry remains solid and that investors should avoid excessive anxiety or panic selling.

Before the meeting, the South Korean market fell sharply again on Friday (20); the KOSPI plunged 5.2% to a ten‑month low, the KOSDAQ also dropped more than 5%, with the KOSPI closing at 4,869.96 points, down 267.93 points or 5.21%, breaking the 5,000‑point barrier for the first time in three trading days.
The South Korean market is viewed as a bellwether for AI investment; as concerns over valuations and rising debt deepen, investors are withdrawing their funds.

items.title: 歐盟擬向科技巨頭課徵3%數位稅 2.04兆歐元預算修訂案引發法德分歧
items.title_en: EU Plans 3% Digital Tax on Tech Giants, 2.04 Trillion‑Euro Budget Revision Sparks France‑Germany Rift
paras: 歐洲理事會主席科斯塔(Antonio Costa)周六(21日)提出歐盟 2028 至 2034 年長期預算(MFF)最新修訂草案。為了減輕各國直接財政負擔，科斯塔主張向全球大型科技企業課徵 3% 數位服務稅，並同步開徵電子廢棄物稅與提高菸草稅。
然而，新草案將歐盟執委會(European Commission)原先規劃的預算大砍 2,040 億歐元，引發法國與德國等核心成員國在「削減支出」與「維持產業與農業補貼」上的強烈對立。

課徵3%數位稅

科斯塔本次提出的全新收入管道，核心在於建立歐盟的「自有資源」，用以補足財政缺口並降低成員國的年度撥款壓力。根據草案內容，數位服務稅將鎖定雙重門檻企業：在歐盟境內年度數位業務營收達 5,000 萬歐元以上，且全球年度總營收超過 7.5 億歐元的大型科技巨頭。
符合標準的企業，需就其在歐盟境內的線上廣告、數位中介服務以及使用者生成數據等業務，按年度淨營業額的 3% 繳納稅款。
此外，歐盟計畫針對電子廢棄物徵稅、調高菸草稅，並探索加密資產稅與無線電頻譜拍賣收益。歐盟理事會估算，這些新開闢的自有資源每年可帶來約 600 億歐元的進帳。
針對外界疑慮，科斯塔特別強調：「這項稅收絕非針對任何特定公司或國家。」不過外界普遍認為，此舉恐將引發美國總統川普政府的強烈反彈。

成員國陣營強烈對立

儘管科斯塔對草案寄予厚望，宣稱「我相信這項提案能讓我們更接近最終協議」，但修訂草案一出，隨即遭到節儉派成員國與農業支持派雙向夾擊。
以德國為首的節儉派國家認為預算規模依然過重。德國總理梅爾茨(Friedrich Merz)直言，預算的「整體規模依然過高」，並強調「幾乎所有成員國」都必須在國內進行財政整頓。瑞典歐洲事務部長羅森克蘭茨(Jessica Rosencrantz)在社群媒體 X 上警示：「我們距離達成妥協還有很長一段路要走。」主張歐盟應將重點放在削減支出與減輕各國出資負擔上。
身為歐盟第二大經濟體及淨出資國的法國，則強烈反對過度削減預算。法國總統馬克宏(Emmanuel Macron)辦公室發表聲明，批評提案「令人深感失望」，特別是在共同農業政策(CAP)與農民收入支持方面遠低於需求，強調「就目前而言，歐洲理事會主席的這份提案無法做為達成協議的基礎」。
這份修訂草案將成為下周布魯塞爾歐盟領袖峰會的交鋒焦點。科斯塔極力爭取在 2026 年 12 月底前達成共識，主因是擔心談判若拖延至 2027 年，隨著法國等地將迎來大選，疑歐派政黨的崛起可能讓未來協商更難達成共識。
paras_en: EU Council President Antonio Costa on Saturday (the 21st) presented the latest revision of the EU’s 2028‑2034 long‑term budget (MFF). To ease the direct fiscal burden on member states, Costa proposes a 3% digital services tax on large global tech firms, alongside new e‑waste and higher tobacco taxes.

However, the new draft slashes the European Commission’s original budget by €204 billion, sparking a sharp clash between core members such as France and Germany over “spending cuts” versus “maintaining industry and agricultural subsidies.”

A 3% Digital Tax
Costa’s new revenue stream aims to create an EU “own resource” to fill fiscal gaps and reduce annual allocations to member states. Under the draft, the digital services tax will target firms that meet a dual threshold: annual digital revenues of at least €50 million within the EU and total worldwide annual turnover exceeding €750 million.
Qualifying companies must pay 3% of their net annual turnover derived from online advertising, digital intermediary services and user‑generated data within the EU.

In addition, the EU plans to levy a tax on e‑waste, raise tobacco duties, and explore taxes on crypto assets and revenues from radio‑spectrum auctions. The Council estimates these new own‑resource streams could generate roughly €60 billion a year.

Addressing external concerns, Costa stressed, “This tax is not aimed at any specific company or country.” Nonetheless, observers widely expect a strong backlash from the United States under President Trump’s administration.

Member‑State Camps Clash
Although Costa is optimistic, saying “I believe this proposal brings us closer to a final agreement,” the revised draft was immediately caught between fiscally‑conservative states and those backing agricultural support.

Led by Germany, the fiscally‑conservative bloc argues the budget remains too large. German Chancellor Friedrich Merz bluntly said the “overall size is still too high” and stressed that “almost all member states” must tighten domestic finances. Sweden’s European Affairs Minister Jessica Rosencrantz warned on X that “we have a long way to go before reaching a compromise,” urging the EU to focus on cutting spending and easing national contributions.

France, the EU’s second‑largest economy and net contributor, strongly opposes deep cuts. President Emmanuel Macron’s office issued a statement calling the proposal “deeply disappointing,” especially on the Common Agricultural Policy and farmer income support, and stressed that “as it stands, the Council President’s proposal cannot serve as a basis for an agreement.”

The revised draft will be the focal point of next week’s EU leaders summit in Brussels. Costa is pushing to secure a consensus by the end of December 2026, fearing that delays into 2027 could coincide with elections in France and elsewhere, potentially empowering Eurosceptic parties and making future negotiations even harder.

items.title: 華爾街日報：民主黨擬定針對川普調查重點 白宮批政治騙局拒配合
items.title_en: Wall Street Journal: Democrats Draft Investigation Focus on Trump; White House Calls It a Political Scam and Refuses to Cooperate
paras: 據《華爾街日報》報導，預計接任美國眾議院監督委員會主席的加州民主黨聯邦眾議員賈西亞(Robert Garcia)，日前向前總統川普家族及政府官員發出12封保存紀錄通知信，預告民主黨在明年新一屆國會取得傳票權後將發動密集調查。
賈西亞公開宣示：「這僅僅是個開始。」
民主黨擬定的調查重點鎖定四大領域：

一、家族商業利益：信中指控小唐納·川普(Donald Trump Jr.)與埃里克·川普(Eric Trump)利用家族加密貨幣企業 World Liberty Financial 謀利。對此，該公司發言人反駁調查是「毫無根據的政治迫害」，強調公司符合所有法律。此外，川普女婿庫許納(Jared Kushner)收取的高額費用與前大使Kimberly Guilfoyle涉嫌索費事宜，也遭質疑為變相酬金。
二、移民執法疑雲：前國土安全部長Kristi Noem被控將合約頒給捐款者；前特別雇員Corey Lewandowski則遭指向私營拘留所業者索酬，其發言人回應稱賈西亞編造誤導說法，「將在適當場合證明是錯誤的」。前幕僚長米勒推行逮捕配額與大搜捕亦受調查。
三、白宮建設與愛潑斯坦案：民主黨關注耗資逾6億美元的白宮新宴會廳建設，質疑半導體巨頭輝達在獲准售晶片後捐款的動機。愛潑斯坦案方面，賈西亞要求副總統范斯與前幕僚長威爾斯提供會議紀錄，質疑政府保護川普；司法部長Todd Blanche則否認Ghislaine Maxwell獲得移監優待，強調因生命安全威脅才轉移。
四、白宮強烈反擊：白宮發言人Lauren Bis直斥調查純屬「騙局」。白宮法律顧問Will Scharf致信表明政府絕不配合少數黨要求，並警告賈西亞，缺乏正當立法目的的調查恐「越界構成公然的犯罪行為」。兩黨國會監督角力即將全面升溫。
paras_en: According to the Wall Street Journal, Robert Garcia, a Democratic U.S. Representative from California who is expected to become chair of the House Oversight Committee, recently sent 12 preservation‑notice letters to members of the Trump family and government officials, warning that Democrats will launch an intensive investigation once the new Congress gains subpoena power next year.
Garcia publicly declared, “This is just the beginning.”
The Democrats’ proposed investigation targets four major areas:

1. Family business interests: The letters allege that Donald Trump Jr. and Eric Trump profited from the family’s cryptocurrency venture, World Liberty Financial. A company spokesperson dismissed the probe as “baseless political persecution,” insisting the firm complies with all laws. The high fees paid to Jared Kushner and alleged fee‑seeking by former ambassador Kimberly Guilfoyle are also being questioned as disguised compensation.

2. Immigration‑enforcement concerns: Former Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem is accused of awarding contracts to donors; former special employee Corey Lewandowski is alleged to have solicited payments from private detention‑facility operators, with his spokesperson saying Garcia fabricated misleading statements that “will be proven wrong at the appropriate time.” Former chief of staff Miller’s arrest‑quota program and large‑scale raids are also under scrutiny.

3. White House construction and the Epstein case: Democrats are focusing on the more than $600 million new White House banquet hall, questioning the motives of semiconductor giant Nvidia after it was allowed to sell chips following a donation. In the Epstein matter, Garcia has asked Vice President Kamala Harris and former chief of staff William Wells for meeting minutes, alleging government protection of Trump; Attorney General Todd Blanche denied that Ghislaine Maxwell received preferential treatment in prison, emphasizing that a transfer was made due to safety threats.

4. White House strong rebuttal: White House spokesperson Lauren Bis labeled the investigation a “scam.” White House legal counsel Will Scharf wrote that the administration will not cooperate with the minority party’s request and warned Garcia that an investigation lacking a legitimate legislative purpose could “overstep and constitute an outright criminal act.” The partisan battle over congressional oversight is set to heat up.

items.title: 韓股暴跌 散戶已無現金攤平！26兆韓元融資面臨斷頭風暴
items.title_en: Korean Stocks Plunge, Retail Investors Run Out of Cash to Average Down! 26 Trillion Won Margin Debt Faces Liquidation Storm
paras: 南韓股市重挫之際，散戶投資人正面臨資金告罄與斷頭平倉的雙重危機。南韓KOSPI指數周五(20日)大跌5.21%，收在4,869.96點，失守4,900點大關；KOSDAQ指數下挫5.71%。半導體巨頭三星電子與SK海力士分別重挫7.01%與5.92%，雙雙觸發邊車(Sidecar)暫停交易機制。
當日外資與機構法人在KOSPI各自賣超約1兆韓元，散戶雖逆勢逢低接刀，在兩大市場合計買超1.8184兆韓元(KOSPI買超1.5381兆韓元、KOSDAQ買超2,803億韓元)，但後續逢低加碼攤平的「子彈」已急劇枯竭。
據南韓金融投資協會(KOFIA)最新統計，截至19日，南韓證券市場的投資人備用資金(客戶保證金)降至81.5669兆韓元，相較於12日的92.2347兆韓元，短短一周內大幅蒸發10.6678兆韓元(減幅達11.57%)，相當於平均每天有1.52兆韓元資金離開市場。
《Financial News》報導，投資人在股市下跌初期，通常會動用閒置資金與帳戶餘額逢低攤平，但當市場暴跌成為常態，資金便會消耗殆盡，「無論股票看起來多麼便宜，沒有子彈就無法扣動扳機」，這顯示市場隨時可用於加碼的後備火力已嚴重受創。
比資金乾涸更令人擔憂的，是高高掛起的槓桿融資餘額。截至19日，韓股融資貸款餘額仍高達26.0832兆韓元(KOSPI占20.2068兆韓元，KOSDAQ占5.8764兆韓元)，未結算應收帳款達9,700億韓元。
散戶用自有資金買股還能忍受虧損等待反彈，但融資買股無法等待，分析師估算，若投資人以500萬韓元本金搭配500萬韓元融資買進股票，當股價下跌30%時，本金即遭吞噬60%。一旦維持率跌破門檻，券商將展開強制平倉(斷頭)，高達26兆韓元的融資餘額，恐演變成「股價下跌觸發斷頭、斷頭賣壓再壓低股價」的連鎖惡性循環。
雪上加霜的是，韓股20日收盤後，美股爆發重挫海嘯，那斯達克指數大跌5.13%，費城半導體指數崩跌逾10%，AI龍頭輝達單日暴跌14.01%，這使得23日(周一)開盤將是對南韓股市資金承載能力與市場供需極限的嚴峻考驗。
paras_en: South Korea’s stock market suffered a sharp decline, leaving retail investors facing a double crisis of depleted cash and forced liquidation. The KOSPI index fell 5.21% on Friday (the 20th), closing at 4,869.96 points and slipping below the 4,900‑point threshold; the KOSDAQ index dropped 5.71%. Semiconductor giants Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix slid 7.01% and 5.92% respectively, both triggering the Sidecar trading‑halt mechanism.

On the same day, foreign and institutional investors sold roughly 1 trillion won each on the KOSPI. Retail investors, buying the dip against the trend, net‑bought 1.8184 trillion won across the two markets (1.5381 trillion won on the KOSPI and 280.3 billion won on the KOSDAQ), but the “bullets” they hoped to use for further averaging down have rapidly run out.

According to the latest figures from the Korea Financial Investment Association (KOFIA), as of the 19th the reserve funds (client margin) in South Korea’s securities market fell to 81.5669 trillion won, down from 92.2347 trillion won on the 12th – a sharp evaporation of 10.6678 trillion won (11.57%) in just one week, equivalent to an average daily outflow of about 1.52 trillion won.

Financial News reported that investors typically dip into idle cash and account balances to average down when a market first falls, but when sharp declines become the norm, those funds are exhausted. “No matter how cheap a stock looks, without bullets you can’t pull the trigger,” the article said, indicating that the market’s backup firepower for additional buying has been severely damaged.

Even more concerning than the cash shortage is the towering leveraged‑margin balance. As of the 19th, margin loans on Korean stocks remained at a staggering 26.0832 trillion won (20.2068 trillion won on the KOSPI and 5.8764 trillion won on the KOSDAQ), with unsettled receivables amounting to 970 billion won.

Retail investors can endure losses with their own capital while waiting for a rebound, but those who bought on margin cannot. Analysts estimate that if an investor uses 5 million won of own money matched with 5 million won of borrowed funds to purchase a stock, a 30% price drop would wipe out 60% of the equity. Once the maintenance margin falls below the required level, brokers will trigger forced liquidations. The 26 trillion won of outstanding margin could spark a vicious chain reaction: falling prices trigger liquidations, which add sell pressure and push prices even lower.

To make matters worse, after the Korean market closed on the 20th, U.S. equities suffered a severe sell‑off. The Nasdaq plunged 5.13%, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell more than 10%, and AI leader Nvidia tumbled 14.01% in a single day. This sets up a harsh test on Monday the 23rd for the South Korean market’s capacity to absorb capital and its supply‑demand limits.

items.title: 狂發30張照片回味APEC！川普曬與普丁合影 標註「我的朋友」
items.title_en: Trump Floods Social Media with 30 Photos Reliving APEC, Posts Putin Photo Labeled “My Friend”
paras: 結束中國深圳的亞太經濟合作會議(APEC)後，美國總統川普周六(21日)在社群平台上，一口氣發表30多張會議照片，高調在與俄羅斯總統普丁的合照標註「我的朋友」(My Friend)，並於白宮記者會與專訪中辯護表示，與擁有4,000枚核武器的國家領導人交友是一件好事。
川普與普丁在APEC期間，舉行了約40分鐘的場邊會談，會前川普在媒體鏡頭前微笑指向普丁稱：「這是誰？這是我的朋友。」
俄羅斯總統外交助理烏沙科夫(Yuri Ushakov)證實，雙方討論了和平解決烏克蘭戰爭的方案，美方特使庫許納(Jared Kushner)澄清，任何協議都會與烏克蘭及歐洲密切協商，絕非單方面強加。
然而，川普高調展現的友誼引發歐洲盟友強烈疑慮。波蘭總理圖斯克(Donald Tusk)在社群平台 X 上感嘆：「願上帝保佑我們免受這種朋友的傷害」，並強調普丁絕非歐洲的朋友。波蘭外長席科爾斯基(Radosław Sikorski)表示，川普擁抱普丁的畫面令人憂心，讓人質疑關鍵時刻川普究竟會選擇波蘭還是普丁。

波蘭國防部長柯西尼亞克-卡密希(Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz)指出，俄軍連夜以飛彈與無人機侵犯波蘭領空，顯示地緣威脅近在咫尺。此外，烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基(Volodymyr Zelenskyy)對此苦笑攤手未作回應；丹麥首相佛瑞德里克森(Mette Frederiksen)形容會晤「令人極難理解」；德國總理梅爾茨(Friedrich Merz)則警告切莫讓會談演變為二戰末期瓜分歐洲的「雅爾達會議」重演。
不過，部分盟友試圖緩和氛圍。英國首相柏南(Andy Burnham)指出，川普並未陷於普丁的魅力攻勢，反而在會中極為關切戰爭造成的慘重生命損失；北約秘書長呂特(Mark Rutte)也為核武大國外交對話的必要性進行辯護。
對於主辦城市深圳，川普盛讚城市發展規模與成就。川普返回美國後召開記者會表示，深圳「完美得無可挑剔」。他指出深圳僅在短短 40 年內，就從一座小漁村發展成如今的現代化大都市規模。
川普特別提到自己仔細觀察了深圳的基礎建設，稱讚其道路與護欄不僅沒有坑坑窪窪，甚至連修補補綴的痕跡都沒有，並對當地的建設與維護工作表達了高度尊重。
在深圳期間，川普讚許深圳是「非常棒的城市」，同時感到遺憾與「惋惜」，認為媒體的報導遠無法完整展現這座城市的全景。
paras_en: After the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, China, U.S. President Donald Trump posted more than 30 photos from the meeting on Saturday (the 21st), boldly labeling a picture with Russian President Vladimir Putin as “My Friend” and defending the friendship at a White House press briefing and interview, saying it’s a good thing to be friends with the leader of a nation that possesses 4,000 nuclear weapons.
During APEC, Trump and Putin held a roughly 40‑minute side meeting. Before the talks, Trump smiled at the cameras and pointed at Putin, saying, “Who’s this? This is my friend.”

Russian presidential aide Yuri Ushakov confirmed that the two leaders discussed a peaceful solution to the war in Ukraine. U.S. envoy Jared Kushner clarified that any agreement would be negotiated closely with Ukraine and Europe, not imposed unilaterally.

Trump’s high‑profile display of friendship sparked strong concerns among European allies. Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk wrote on X, “May God protect us from the harm of such friends,” stressing that Putin is not Europe’s friend. Polish Foreign Minister Radosław Sikorski said the image of Trump embracing Putin was worrisome and raised doubts about whether Trump would side with Poland or Putin in a critical moment.

Polish Defence Minister Władysław Kosiniak‑Kamysz noted that Russian forces overnight violated Polish airspace with missiles and drones, showing the geographic threat is immediate. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy merely smiled wryly and gave no comment; Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen called the meeting “hard to understand”; German Chancellor Friedrich Merz warned that the talks must not turn into a post‑World‑War‑II “Yalta”‑type partition of Europe.

Some allies tried to soften the atmosphere. British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Trump was not swayed by Putin’s charm offensive but was deeply concerned about the massive loss of life caused by the war; NATO Secretary‑General Mark Rutte also defended the necessity of diplomatic dialogue between nuclear‑armed powers.

Trump praised Shenzhen’s scale of development and achievements. After returning to the United States, he held a press conference calling Shenzhen “perfectly flawless,” noting that in just 40 years the city had grown from a small fishing village into a modern metropolis.

Trump specifically said he had closely observed Shenzhen’s infrastructure, complimenting its roads and guardrails for being free of potholes and even lacking any repair marks, and expressed high respect for the city’s construction and maintenance work.
While in Shenzhen, Trump described the city as “a very great city,” while also expressing regret and “sorrow,” saying media coverage falls far short of fully portraying the city’s full picture.

items.title: 馬斯克警告：AI產業2027年將面臨數千億美元資金短缺危機
items.title_en: Musk Warns AI Industry Could Face a Multi‑Hundred‑Billion‑Dollar Funding Shortfall by 2027
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克(Elon Musk)周六(21日)警告，全球人工智慧(AI)產業在 2027 年，恐將迎來高達數千億美元的資金短缺危機。
馬斯克在社群平台 X 上與 AI 研究員François Chollet對談時表示，儘管市場對算力的需求依然旺盛，但產業正面臨「在收益進帳前就把現金耗盡」的財務瓶頸。
AI 研究員Chollet指出，目前全球對算力的需求極為強勁，GPU 顯示卡現貨價格持續攀升，高頻寬記憶體(HBM)與 DRAM 產能早已被訂購一空。對此，馬斯克回應強調，危機的核心在於硬體採購與實現獲利之間的時間差，而非需求不足。企業必須在獲得客戶付費前數月，提前採購晶片、興建數據中心、爭取龐大電力並建置冷卻系統。
馬斯克說：「讓如此大規模的算力上線、冷卻並穩定運作極為困難。購買算力到穩定變現之間只要出現幾個月的延遲，就會創造出數千億美元的額外營運資金缺口。」
此外，電力與基礎設施瓶頸進一步延緩部署，馬斯克先前亦預估 2027 年全球 AI 晶片部署將面臨至少 15 GW 的電力缺口。
高盛的數據顯示，2026 年全球 AI 相關資本支出已逼近 1 兆美元，累積債務發行量高達約 6,000 億美元。馬斯克透露，旗下 SpaceX 雖於 2026 年 10 月完成約 400 億美元的債務融資以購入 GPU，但他警告，債務市場對缺乏數據中心以外實質營收的新興雲端服務商(neocloud providers)正迅速關閉融資大門。
在信貸緊縮與投資人態度轉趨謹慎下，馬斯克預測，AI 數據中心領域將有超過 200 家企業面臨併購潮或直接倒閉。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk warned on Saturday (the 21st) that the global artificial intelligence (AI) industry could encounter a funding shortfall of up to several hundred billion dollars by 2027.

In a conversation on the X platform with AI researcher François Chollet, Musk said that although demand for compute power remains strong, the industry is hitting a financial bottleneck of "burning cash before any revenue comes in."

Chollet noted that worldwide demand for compute is extremely strong, GPU spot prices keep climbing, and capacity for high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and DRAM has already been fully booked. Musk replied that the crisis stems from the time lag between hardware procurement and profit realization, not from insufficient demand. Companies must purchase chips, build data centers, secure massive power supplies and install cooling systems months before customers actually pay.

Musk said: "Getting such massive compute online, cooled and running reliably is extremely difficult. A delay of just a few months between buying compute and turning it into stable revenue creates an extra operating‑capital gap of several hundred billion dollars."
He added that power‑and‑infrastructure bottlenecks further slow deployment, and Musk previously estimated that global AI‑chip deployment will face at least a 15 GW power shortfall in 2027.

Goldman Sachs data show that global AI‑related capital spending is approaching $1 trillion in 2026, with cumulative debt issuance around $600 billion. Musk disclosed that SpaceX completed roughly $40 billion of debt financing in October 2026 to buy GPUs, but warned that the debt market is rapidly shutting its doors to emerging cloud providers (neocloud providers) that lack data‑center‑related revenue beyond the hardware itself.
Amid tightening credit and more cautious investors, Musk predicts that over 200 companies in the AI data‑center space will face a wave of mergers and acquisitions or outright failure.

items.title: 伊朗宣稱擊中巴林美軍雷達 沙烏地攔截一枚飛彈
items.title_en: Iran Claims to Hit US Radar in Bahrain, Saudi Arabia Intercepts a Missile
paras: 伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊(IRGC)周六(21日)宣稱發射飛彈與無人機，擊中美軍設於巴林的防空雷達系統，以報復美軍侵犯其領空及襲擊雷達站。另一方面，沙烏地阿拉伯成功攔截襲擊其重要原油出口終端站的飛彈，而荷姆茲海峽周邊接連發生油輪遇襲事件。
根據伊朗國營媒體報導，革命衛隊針對巴林阿爾里法(al-Riffa)與阿瓦利(Awali)基地的美軍愛國者防空雷達發動打擊。巴林內政部證實一處民營工業設施在「伊朗侵略」中起火，所幸無人傷亡，隨後發布安全解除通知。革命衛隊還宣稱在荷姆茲海峽擊落美軍MQ-9與MQ-1無人機。
此外，由沙烏地主導的聯軍表示，已成功攔截並摧毀一枚朝向沙烏地西部延布(Yanbu)原油出口終端站發射的胡塞組織(青年運動)彈道飛彈，以及先前飛往利雅德的無人機。
伊朗外交政策與國家安全委員會發言人Ebrahim Rezaei警告，若伊朗的煉油廠或電廠遭襲，伊朗將全力打擊以色列的基礎設施。伊朗副外長Kazem Gharibabadi指責美國的經濟封鎖是「戰爭行為」，並強調濃縮核原料「在任何情況下」都不會移出伊朗。
伊朗軍方發言人准將Mohammad Akraminia表示，美國任何新侵略都將面臨「果斷且立即的回應」，美方必須接受伊朗條件以結束戰爭。
美國總統川普周六接受採訪時重申，他希望達成一項永久協議，阻止伊朗獲得核武器，即使「在4年、15年或20年後，我們迎來一位無能的總統」。
他形容伊朗領導層「非常難對付，且經常在協議達成次日毀約」。
針對伊朗宣稱擊傷美軍戰機的說法，美軍中央司令部予以否認，強調中東地區所有美軍F-16戰鬥機均安全無虞。
航運安全方面，英國海事貿易行動辦公室(UKMTO)指出，兩艘離開荷姆茲海峽的油輪在阿曼外海遭「不明拋射物」擊中，海峽威脅等級已調升至「嚴重」。
海峽船隻通行量較戰前驟降約65%，受到衝突衝擊，倫敦布蘭特原油期貨價格維持在每桶83.62美元的高位，顯著高於戰前水準。
paras_en: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said on Saturday (the 21st) that it launched missiles and drones that struck a US air‑defense radar system stationed in Bahrain, claiming retaliation for US incursions into its airspace and attacks on radar sites. Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia successfully intercepted a missile aimed at a key oil‑export terminal, and a series of attacks on tankers have occurred around the Hormuz Strait.

According to Iran’s state media, the Revolutionary Guard targeted US Patriot air‑defense radars at the al‑Riffa and Awali bases in Bahrain. Bahrain’s interior ministry confirmed that a private industrial facility caught fire during the "Iranian aggression," but there were no casualties and a safety clearance was later issued. The Guard also claimed to have shot down US MQ‑9 and MQ‑1 drones over the Hormuz Strait.

In addition, a Saudi‑led coalition said it had successfully intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched by the Houthi youth movement toward the Yanbu oil‑export terminal in western Saudi Arabia, as well as a drone that was previously heading toward Riyadh.

Ebrahim Rezaei, spokesperson for Iran’s Foreign Policy and National Security Committee, warned that if Iran’s refineries or power plants were attacked, Iran would fully strike Israeli infrastructure. Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi accused the United States of an "act of war" with its economic blockade and stressed that enriched nuclear material would not be moved out of Iran under any circumstances.

Iranian military spokesman Brigadier General Mohammad Akraminia said any new US aggression would meet a "decisive and immediate response," and that the United States must accept Iran’s conditions to end the war.

U.S. President Donald Trump reiterated in an interview on Saturday that he wants a permanent deal to prevent Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons, even if "in four, fifteen or twenty years we get an incompetent president."
He described Iran’s leadership as "very difficult to deal with and often reneges on agreements the day after they are reached."
The US Central Command denied Iran's claim of having damaged US aircraft, emphasizing that all US F‑16 fighter jets in the Middle East remain safe and operational.

Regarding maritime safety, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported that two tankers leaving the Hormuz Strait were hit by "unidentified projectiles" in Omani waters, prompting the threat level for the strait to be raised to "severe."
Ship traffic through the strait has fallen about 65% from pre‑war levels due to the conflict, while London Brent crude futures have stayed high at $83.62 a barrel, well above pre‑war prices.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走軟 日元、瑞郎強升 比特幣跌破6萬美元
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Weakens, Yen and Franc Rally, Bitcoin Falls Below $60,000
paras: 美元指數週五 (20 日) 小幅走低，終止連八個交易日上漲。市場對人工智慧 (AI) 產業的疑慮持續衝擊全球股市，資金轉進美國公債避險，帶動殖利率下滑，推升日元與瑞郎。不過，聯準會 (Fed) 官員持續釋出鷹派訊號，加上市場降低對風險貨幣的持有意願，限制美元跌幅。
美股尾盤時段，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣表現的美元指數下跌 0.07%，至 103.87，仍接近前一交易日觸及、2025 年 4 月以來的最高水準。
美元這波漲勢在 11 月 10 日加速，當時美國通膨數據高於預期，強化市場對聯準會進一步緊縮政策的押注。聯準會理事沃勒 (Christopher Waller) 也表示，應考慮在 12 月升息 2 碼。
Bannockburn Capital Markets 首席市場策略師 Marc Chandler 表示：「我認為美元的上漲動能已經停滯……但現在就認定美元已經見頂，還有點太早。」
美債避險買盤湧現 日元、瑞郎受惠
AI 相關疑慮持續壓抑全球股市，Anthropic (ANT-US) 週四創紀錄的上市案，也未能有效提振投資人信心。資金週五轉向公債避險，推動美債殖利率下滑，提高日元與瑞郎等低利率貨幣的相對吸引力。
Chandler 表示：「當美國利率下降時，低收益貨幣就顯得更具吸引力。」
美元兌瑞郎下跌 0.51%，報 1 美元可兌換 0.8396 瑞郎；美元兌日元下跌 0.73%，報 1 美元可兌換 158.50 日元，顯示瑞郎與日元雙雙兌美元升值。日元匯價仍接近日本當局今年 7 月進場干預、支撐日元時的水準。
除了美債殖利率下降，日本通膨數據也提供日元支撐。日本 10 月核心消費者物價指數 (CPI) 年增率加速至 2.2%，連續第二個月高於日本銀行的 2% 目標，顯示物價壓力擴散，強化日銀近期升息的理由。
Chandler 指出：「日元今天走強，受到美國利率下降，以及日本 10 月 CPI 表現強勁的帶動。」
凱投宏觀分析師認為，日元近期的疲弱走勢不太可能持續。
隨著日本長期通膨預期已接近目標，殖利率進一步上升將主要反映實質利率提高，加上該機構預期美債殖利率將下降，兩項因素應有利日元。
聯準會維持鷹派 川普再批利率過高
儘管美元回落，策略師認為，聯準會偏向升息的政策前景仍將提供支撐。
ING 全球市場主管 Chris Turner 表示，雖然目前支持股市再度大幅修正的理由有限，但「聯準會沒有理由在短期內放棄鷹派論調」。
他指出，下週公布的美國個人消費支出物價指數 (PCE)，可能進一步確認聯準會有必要採取行動。
聯準會理事庫克 (Lisa Cook) 週五也支持進一步升息，表示目前政策利率不足以因應通膨，並稱她對通膨水準「深感憂慮」。
美國總統川普則在週五記者會上表示，目前利率過高，並批評聯準會具有「政治性」。
其他主要貨幣方面，歐元兌美元小跌至 1.0963 美元；英鎊兌美元下跌至 1.3080 美元，仍徘徊在一年低點附近。澳元與紐元分別下跌 0.71% 及 0.36%，反映風險貨幣持續承壓。
加密貨幣也遭拋售浪潮襲擊。
隨著投資人擔憂 AI 相關資產估值過高，賣壓擴及其他風險資產，比特幣週五跌破 6 萬美元，為 7 月以來首見，報導更新時下跌約 6%，至 57,939 美元。
